plugin_asdk_app_6a057d268ebc81919918d37e.longDescription: Reach an authorized computer's filesystem and terminal from ChatGPT through Desktop Commander's Remote MCP. The app relays a secure connection to a machine the user controls so ChatGPT can inspect files, run commands, manage processes, edit local documents, and automate development workflows from chat. Users stay in control of which devices are connected and can disconnect them at any time.

plugin_asdk_app_6a057d268ebc81919918d37e.productIntro: Remote Desktop Commander 通过用户授权的远程连接，让 Codex 查看另一台电脑的文件、执行终端命令并处理文档；适合确实需要跨设备操作的任务。

plugin_asdk_app_693a0a79ffe4819190117307.description: 通过聊天构建全栈应用程序
plugin_asdk_app_693a0a79ffe4819190117307.productIntro: Lovable 使用自然语言构建和编辑全栈 Web 应用程序。描述一个应用程序，Lovable 创建一个项目，编写 TypeScript、Tailwind 和 shadcn/ui 代码，并返回您可以观看构建的实时预览。后续消息将完善应用程序，您可以检查生成的代码和差异、添加 PostgreSQL 数据库和第三方连接器、管理可重用的项目知识和技能，并将完成的应用程序发布到公共 URL。
plugin_asdk_app_693a0a79ffe4819190117307.productIntroEn: Lovable builds and edits full-stack web apps from natural language. Describe an app and Lovable creates a project, writes the TypeScript, Tailwind, and shadcn/ui code, and returns a live preview you can watch build.
plugin_asdk_app_693a0a79ffe4819190117307.longDescription: Lovable builds and edits full-stack web apps from natural language. Describe an app and Lovable creates a project, writes the TypeScript, Tailwind, and shadcn/ui code, and returns a live preview you can watch build. Follow-up messages refine the app, and you can inspect the generated code and diffs, add a PostgreSQL database and third-party connectors, manage reusable project knowledge and skills, and publish the finished app to a public URL.
plugin_asdk_app_693a0a79ffe4819190117307.longDescriptionZh: Lovable 使用自然语言构建和编辑全栈 Web 应用程序。描述一个应用程序，Lovable 创建一个项目，编写 TypeScript、Tailwind 和 shadcn/ui 代码，并返回您可以观看构建的实时预览。后续消息将完善应用程序，您可以检查生成的代码和差异、添加 PostgreSQL 数据库和第三方连接器、管理可重用的项目知识和技能，并将完成的应用程序发布到公共 URL。

plugin_asdk_app_6a258ab1e0908191aa647c33.name: GSC Wizard
plugin_asdk_app_6a258ab1e0908191aa647c33.productIntro: GSC 向导将 ChatGPT 连接到您自己的 Google Search Console 属性，以便您可以用简单的语言分析 SEO 性能。询问效果摘要、您的热门查询和页面、两个时期之间的排名变化、内容衰减、关键词蚕食、点击率与位置曲线或完整的 SEO 报告，并获得完整的答复。每个分析都是在服务器端针对数据仓库进行计算，而不是将数千个原始行流式传输到模型中，因此结果快速、准确且高效。
plugin_asdk_app_6a258ab1e0908191aa647c33.productIntroEn: GSC Wizard connects ChatGPT to your own Google Search Console properties so you can analyze SEO performance in plain language. Ask for a performance summary, your top queries and pages, ranking changes between two periods, content decay, keyword cannibalization, CTR-versus-position curves, or a full SEO report, and get a finished answer back.
plugin_asdk_app_6a258ab1e0908191aa647c33.longDescription: GSC Wizard connects ChatGPT to your own Google Search Console properties so you can analyze SEO performance in plain language. Ask for a performance summary, your top queries and pages, ranking changes between two periods, content decay, keyword cannibalization, CTR-versus-position curves, or a full SEO report, and get a finished answer back. Instead of streaming thousands of raw rows into the model, every analysis is computed server-side against a data warehouse, so results are fast, accurate, and token-efficient. You can also list and inspect properties, run Google's URL Inspection, track indexing, manage topic clusters and content groups, and submit URLs to IndexNow. It also reports on your own linked Google Analytics 4 properties: traffic overviews, dimension breakdowns, ecommerce, key events (conversions), traffic referred by AI assistants such as ChatGPT and Perplexity, and blended Search Console + GA4 landing-page views. Summary tools render interactive cards and tables directly in ChatGPT. All access is scoped to your own account through Google sign-in.
plugin_asdk_app_6a258ab1e0908191aa647c33.longDescriptionZh: GSC 向导将 ChatGPT 连接到您自己的 Google Search Console 属性，以便您可以用简单的语言分析 SEO 性能。询问效果摘要、您的热门查询和页面、两个时期之间的排名变化、内容衰减、关键词蚕食、点击率与位置曲线或完整的 SEO 报告，并获得完整的答复。每个分析都是在服务器端针对数据仓库进行计算，而不是将数千个原始行流式传输到模型中，因此结果快速、准确且高效。您还可以列出和检查属性、运行 Google 的 URL 检查、跟踪索引、管理主题集群和内容组以及将 URL 提交到 IndexNow。它还报告您自己链接的 Google Analytics 4 属性：流量概览、维度细分、电子商务、关键事件（转化）、ChatGPT 和 Perplexity 等 AI 助手引用的流量，以及混合的 Search Console + GA4 着陆页视图。摘要工具直接在 ChatGPT 中呈现交互式卡片和表格。所有访问权限均仅限于您通过 Google 登录的帐户。

plugin_asdk_app_6a2b62fd753c8191bcff02ac.description: 使用 WordPress 构建和发布
plugin_asdk_app_6a2b62fd753c8191bcff02ac.productIntro: 描述您的需求，WordPress 会构建它：作品集、餐厅菜单、博客、在线商店。告诉 WordPress 有关您的业务、您的受众以及您需要哪些页面的信息。它规划网站、编写内容、选择设计并在 WordPress.com 上发布。
plugin_asdk_app_6a2b62fd753c8191bcff02ac.productIntroEn: Describe what you need and WordPress builds it: a portfolio, a restaurant menu, a blog, an online store. Tell WordPress about your business, your audience, what pages you need. It plans the site, writes the content, picks a design, and launches it on WordPress.com.
plugin_asdk_app_6a2b62fd753c8191bcff02ac.longDescription:
Describe what you need and WordPress builds it: a portfolio, a restaurant menu, a blog, an online store. Tell WordPress about your business, your audience, what pages you need. It plans the site, writes the content, picks a design, and launches it on WordPress.com. 

Already have a WordPress.com site? Connect it to publish and schedule posts, check your traffic, moderate comments, manage plugins, and update settings. 70+ abilities across your full site. 

WordPress.com's plugin connects ChatGPT or Codex directly to WordPress.com, so you can build a new site or manage an existing one — all through conversation.

If you are running locally in Codex, you can also connect to WordPress Studio for local site builds, theme and plugin development, site edits and site administration.
plugin_asdk_app_6a2b62fd753c8191bcff02ac.longDescriptionZh:
描述您的需求，WordPress 会构建它：作品集、餐厅菜单、博客、在线商店。告诉 WordPress 有关您的业务、您的受众以及您需要哪些页面的信息。它规划网站、编写内容、选择设计并在 WordPress.com 上发布。 

已经有 WordPress.com 网站？连接它来发布和安排帖子、检查流量、审核评论、管理插件和更新设置。整个网站有 70 多种功能。 

WordPress.com 的插件将 ChatGPT 或 Codex 直接连接到 WordPress.com，因此您可以构建新网站或管理现有网站 - 全部通过对话进行。

如果您在 Codex 中本地运行，您还可以连接到 WordPress Studio 进行本地站点构建、主题和插件开发、站点编辑和站点管理。

plugin_asdk_app_69f63e01766881919640f03b.name: SentinelX
plugin_asdk_app_69f63e01766881919640f03b.productIntro: SentinelX 允许您从 ChatGPT 管理 Linux、macOS 和 Windows 服务器 - 无需 SSH。在任何 Linux、macOS 或 Windows 主机上安装小型开源代理，ChatGPT 可以运行检查命令、管理服务（systemd、launchd 或 Windows 服务）、读取/搜索/编辑文件、运行脚本、上传文件以及调用 Cloudflare DNS、Resend 和 Telegram 等集成。
plugin_asdk_app_69f63e01766881919640f03b.productIntroEn: SentinelX lets you manage your Linux, macOS, and Windows servers from ChatGPT — no SSH required. Install a small open-source agent on any Linux, macOS, or Windows host, and ChatGPT can run inspection commands, manage services (systemd, launchd, or Windows services), read/search/edit files, run scripts, upload files, and call out to integrations like Cloudflare DNS, Resend, and Telegram.
plugin_asdk_app_69f63e01766881919640f03b.longDescription:
SentinelX lets you manage your Linux, macOS, and Windows servers from ChatGPT — no SSH required. Install a small open-source agent on any Linux, macOS, or Windows host, and ChatGPT can run inspection commands, manage services (systemd, launchd, or Windows services), read/search/edit files, run scripts, upload files, and call out to integrations like Cloudflare DNS, Resend, and Telegram.

Every action is constrained by a per-host allowlist that you control. The agent only runs commands and services you've explicitly declared safe, rejects anything outside the policy at the agent boundary, and your OS's file permissions still apply on top. You can connect multiple hosts and label them however you want.

Typical uses: check uptime and disk space, restart services, tail logs, edit config files, run quick scripts, manage DNS records, send notifications. The agent is open source on GitHub (github.com/pensados/sentinelx-cloud-core). Authentication uses OAuth 2.0 with PKCE and Dynamic Client Registration, scoped per user.
plugin_asdk_app_69f63e01766881919640f03b.longDescriptionZh:
SentinelX 允许您从 ChatGPT 管理 Linux、macOS 和 Windows 服务器 - 无需 SSH。在任何 Linux、macOS 或 Windows 主机上安装小型开源代理，ChatGPT 可以运行检查命令、管理服务（systemd、launchd 或 Windows 服务）、读取/搜索/编辑文件、运行脚本、上传文件以及调用 Cloudflare DNS、Resend 和 Telegram 等集成。

每个操作都受到您控制的每个主机白名单的限制。代理仅运行您明确声明安全的命令和服务，拒绝代理边界上策略之外的任何内容，并且您操作系统的文件权限仍然适用。您可以连接多个主机并根据需要为它们添加标签。

典型用途：检查正常运行时间和磁盘空间、重新启动服务、尾日志、编辑配置文件、运行快速脚本、管理 DNS 记录、发送通知。该代理在 GitHub (github.com/pensados/sentinelx-cloud-core) 上开源。身份验证使用带有 PKCE 和动态客户端注册的 OAuth 2.0，范围为每个用户。

plugin_asdk_app_6a10e1e330788191b7a6af85.name: Hercules
plugin_asdk_app_6a10e1e330788191b7a6af85.productIntro: Hercules 可以通过与 AI 聊天轻松构建应用程序和网站。
plugin_asdk_app_6a10e1e330788191b7a6af85.productIntroEn: Hercules makes it easy to build apps and websites by chatting with AI.
plugin_asdk_app_6a10e1e330788191b7a6af85.longDescription:
Hercules makes it easy to build apps and websites by chatting with AI. 

~~~What can you build?~~~
- Internal tools (like CRMs, ERPs, HR portals, client portals, scheduling software etc)
- Marketing content (like SEO pages, paid ad landing pages, etc)
- B2B SaaS apps (like industry-specific software) 
- E-commerce stores (physical goods, digital goods, events, classes, etc)
- Mobile apps (for Android and iOS)
- Multi-page websites
- Mocks and prototypes
- So much more
You can build any sort of web app or website with Hercules

~~~Why Hercules?~~~
1. No code. No API keys. No DevOps.
2. Everything you need is built in: Hosting, Backend, Database, Auth, Email, Payments, Internationalization, and 25+ other powerful features
3. Scale to millions on world class infrastructure

~~~Who are some of Hercules' customers?~~~
Hercules powers ERPs for logistics companies that do 120k deliveries a day, CRMs for wholesalers with 150 employees, and internal operating systems for home services business doing $10s of millions of revenue. We're built for real business.

~~~How does this chatgpt app work?~~~
1. Tell @Hercules what you want to build ("@Hercules, build a CRM for my wholesale business")
2. Review the live preview 
3. Ask for changes
4. Ask @Hercules to publish
plugin_asdk_app_6a10e1e330788191b7a6af85.longDescriptionZh:
Hercules 可以通过与 AI 聊天轻松构建应用程序和网站。 

~~~你能建造什么？~~~
- 内部工具（如 CRM、ERP、HR 门户、客户门户、调度软件等）
- 营销内容（如 SEO 页面、付费广告登陆页面等）
- B2B SaaS 应用程序（如行业特定软件） 
- 电子商务商店（实体商品、数字商品、活动、课程等）
- 移动应用程序（适用于 Android 和 iOS）
- 多页面网站
- 模拟和原型
- 还有更多
您可以使用 Hercules 构建任何类型的网络应用程序或网站

~~~为什么是大力士？~~~
1.无代码。没有 API 密钥。没有 DevOps。
2. 内置您所需的一切：托管、后端、数据库、身份验证、电子邮件、支付、国际化以及 25 多个其他强大功能
3. 世界一流的基础设施可扩展到数百万人

~~~Hercules 的客户有哪些？~~~
Hercules 为每天交付 12 万件的物流公司提供 ERP，为拥有 150 名员工的批发商提供 CRM，为收入达数百万美元的家庭服务业务提供内部操作系统。我们专为真正的业务而打造。

~~~这个chatgpt应用程序是如何工作的？~~~
1. 告诉 @Hercules 您想要构建什么（“@Hercules，为我的批发业务构建 CRM”）
2.查看实时预览 
3. 要求改变
4. 请求@Hercules 发布

plugin_asdk_app_691f245d4070819184e05b48.originalDescription: Manage, modify, and host your images & videos
plugin_asdk_app_691f245d4070819184e05b48.productIntro: 直接从 Codex 管理、搜索和转换您的 Cloudinary 媒体库。
plugin_asdk_app_691f245d4070819184e05b48.productIntroEn: Manage, search, and transform your Cloudinary media library — directly from Codex.
plugin_asdk_app_691f245d4070819184e05b48.longDescription:
Manage, search, and transform your Cloudinary media library — directly from Codex.

The Cloudinary app connects your Cloudinary account to Codex, giving you full control over your visual assets through natural language. Upload, organize, tag, transform, and analyze images or videos without leaving the chat. 

What You Can Do
- Upload assets from URLs, local files, or base64 data — automatically analyze, tag, or moderate them.
- Browse and search your entire media library using smart filters or text queries (tags, format, date, size, etc.).
- Organize your library — create folders, rename files, manage metadata, and clean up obsolete assets.
- Transform images or videos with Cloudinary’s powerful syntax — resize, crop, watermark, apply filters, or optimize for delivery.
- Generate archives and backups, or restore previous versions when needed.
- Analyze assets with AI — detect faces, extract text, get color palettes, and accessibility scores.
- Monitor usage — track storage, bandwidth, and transformation credits in real time.
- Visual search — find visually similar images by uploading an example or describing it.

Perfect For
- Developers who want to experiment with Cloudinary API commands in natural language.
- Marketers & designers managing campaign visuals and brand assets.
- Teams automating content workflows with Codex or building multi-agent setups.

Turn Codex into a powerful media management assistant with the Cloudinary app.
plugin_asdk_app_691f245d4070819184e05b48.longDescriptionZh:
直接从 Codex 管理、搜索和转换您的 Cloudinary 媒体库。

Cloudinary 应用程序将您的 Cloudinary 帐户连接到 Codex，让您通过自然语言完全控制您的视觉资产。无需离开聊天即可上传、组织、标记、转换和分析图像或视频。 

你能做什么
- 从 URL、本地文件或 Base64 数据上传资产 — 自动分析、标记或审核它们。
- 使用智能过滤器或文本查询（标签、格式、日期、大小等）浏览和搜索整个媒体库。
- 组织您的库 - 创建文件夹、重命名文件、管理元数据并清理过时的资产。
- 使用 Cloudinary 强大的语法转换图像或视频 - 调整大小、裁剪、水印、应用滤镜或优化交付。
- 生成存档和备份，或在需要时恢复以前的版本。
- 使用人工智能分析资产 - 检测面部、提取文本、获取调色板和可访问性分数。
- 监控使用情况 — 实时跟踪存储、带宽和转换积分。
- 视觉搜索 — 通过上传示例或描述来查找视觉上相似的图像。

完美适合
- 想要用自然语言试验 Cloudinary API 命令的开发人员。
- 营销人员和设计师管理活动视觉效果和品牌资产。
- 团队使用 Codex 自动化内容工作流程或构建多代理设置。

使用 Cloudinary 应用程序将 Codex 变成强大的媒体管理助手。

plugin_asdk_app_6a5fa5e2392c8191824fb034.name: MongoDB Atlas
plugin_asdk_app_6a5fa5e2392c8191824fb034.productIntro: 管理 MongoDB Atlas 并查询您的数据。连接到任何 MongoDB 集群或 Atlas 项目以运行查询和聚合、检查架构和索引以及读/写文档。
plugin_asdk_app_6a5fa5e2392c8191824fb034.productIntroEn: Manage MongoDB Atlas and query your data. Connect to any MongoDB cluster or Atlas project to run queries and aggregations, inspect schemas and indexes, and read/write documents.
plugin_asdk_app_6a5fa5e2392c8191824fb034.longDescription:
Manage MongoDB Atlas and query your data. Connect to any MongoDB cluster or Atlas project to run queries and aggregations, inspect schemas and indexes, and read/write documents.

Key features:

* Query and manage data - Run finds, aggregations, and counts; insert, update, or delete documents; create collections and indexes.
* Manage Atlas infrastructure - Create and upgrade clusters, manage database users and IP access lists, and inspect cluster metadata across your projects and organizations.
* Optimize performance - Get index suggestions, schema recommendations, and slow query analysis from the Atlas Performance Advisor.
* Build streaming pipelines - Create, monitor, and manage Atlas Stream Processing workspaces, connections, and processors.
* Search MongoDB knowledge - Query official MongoDB documentation and expert guidance directly from the assistant knowledge base.
plugin_asdk_app_6a5fa5e2392c8191824fb034.longDescriptionZh:
管理 MongoDB Atlas 并查询您的数据。连接到任何 MongoDB 集群或 Atlas 项目以运行查询和聚合、检查架构和索引以及读/写文档。

主要特点：

* 查询和管理数据 - 运行查找、聚合和计数；插入、更新或删除文档；创建集合和索引。
* 管理 Atlas 基础设施 - 创建和升级集群、管理数据库用户和 IP 访问列表以及检查项目和组织中的集群元数据。
* 优化性能 - 从 Atlas Performance Advisor 获取索引建议、架构建议和慢速查询分析。
* 构建流处理管道 - 创建、监控和管理 Atlas Stream Processing 工作区、连接和处理器。
* 搜索MongoDB知识-直接从助手知识库查询MongoDB官方文档和专家指导。

plugin_asdk_app_6984a0b396708191a7856354.name: Keenable
plugin_asdk_app_6984a0b396708191a7856354.productIntro: Keenable 通过两个只读工具提供 ChatGPT 实时网络访问。 Web 搜索返回查询的排名结果，每个结果都带有标题、URL 和片段。获取页面内容获取任何 URL 并以干净的降价形式返回页面的主要内容，因此 ChatGPT 可以读取刚刚找到的源。
plugin_asdk_app_6984a0b396708191a7856354.productIntroEn: Keenable gives ChatGPT live web access through two read-only tools. Web Search returns ranked results for a query, each with a title, URL and snippet. Fetch Page Content takes any URL and returns the page's main content as clean markdown, so ChatGPT can read a source it just found.
plugin_asdk_app_6984a0b396708191a7856354.longDescription:
Keenable gives ChatGPT live web access through two read-only tools. Web Search returns ranked results for a query, each with a title, URL and snippet. Fetch Page Content takes any URL and returns the page's main content as clean markdown, so ChatGPT can read a source it just found.

Connect your Keenable account once to enable it. The intended flow is search to discover sources, then fetch the relevant ones, so an answer can cite what it is based on.
plugin_asdk_app_6984a0b396708191a7856354.longDescriptionZh:

询问“为什么该组织无法使用 SSO 登录？”或“列出具有草稿 SSO 连接的每个组织”，代理会发现正确的操作并运行它。

plugin_asdk_app_69a720e1c9608191b2f10597.productIntro: YepCode 允许您使用自己的代码和 JSON 模式定义的输入构建自定义 AI 工具，在隔离的沙箱中执行，可以访问任何 npm 或 PyPI 包和安全环境变量。
plugin_asdk_app_69a720e1c9608191b2f10597.productIntroEn: YepCode lets you build custom AI tools using your own code with JSON Schema-defined inputs, executed in an isolated sandbox with access to any npm or PyPI package and secure environment variables.
plugin_asdk_app_69a720e1c9608191b2f10597.longDescription:
YepCode lets you build custom AI tools using your own code with JSON Schema-defined inputs, executed in an isolated sandbox with access to any npm or PyPI package and secure environment variables.

Define reusable processes in Node.js or Python, expose them as callable AI tools, and execute them on demand or on a schedule. Every run is logged and auditable, enabling traceable, production-grade AI integrations.

Built for developers who need programmable, observable AI tool execution.
plugin_asdk_app_69a720e1c9608191b2f10597.longDescriptionZh:
YepCode 允许您使用自己的代码和 JSON 模式定义的输入构建自定义 AI 工具，在隔离的沙箱中执行，可以访问任何 npm 或 PyPI 包和安全环境变量。

在 Node.js 或 Python 中定义可重用流程，将它们公开为可调用的 AI 工具，并按需或按计划执行它们。每次运行都会被记录并可审核，从而实现可追踪的生产级人工智能集成。

专为需要可编程、可观察的 AI 工具执行的开发人员而构建。

plugin_asdk_app_69b17914fd508191bcd9d886.name: Sticklight
plugin_asdk_app_69b17914fd508191bcd9d886.productIntro: Sticklight 是一款人工智能驱动的构建器，专为想要更快地构建真正的数字产品的专业网络创建者而设计，同时又不影响质量、控制或设计标准。 您首先用自然语言描述您想要创建的内容，Sticklight 会生成一个工作项目，其中的结构、界面和核心逻辑已经就位。从那里，创建者可以完善每个细节 - 手动编辑元素、调整布局和交互，以及在需要时访问底层代码。这使得专业人员能够完全控制每个像素并保持其工作要求的工艺水平。
plugin_asdk_app_69b17914fd508191bcd9d886.productIntroEn: Sticklight is an AI-powered builder designed for professional web creators who want to build real digital products faster - without compromising on quality, control, or design standards. You start by describing what you want to create in natural language, and Sticklight generates a working project with structure, interface, and core logic already in place.
plugin_asdk_app_69b17914fd508191bcd9d886.longDescription:
Sticklight is an AI-powered builder designed for professional web creators who want to build real digital products faster - without compromising on quality, control, or design standards.
You start by describing what you want to create in natural language, and Sticklight generates a working project with structure, interface, and core logic already in place. From there, creators can refine every detail - manually editing elements, adjusting layouts and interactions, and accessing the underlying code whenever needed. This allows professionals to keep full control over every pixel and maintain the level of craft their work demands.

What makes Sticklight especially valuable for experienced creators is the ability to produce non-generic results. Instead of templated outputs, the platform is designed to support custom design decisions and unique product ideas while still accelerating the building process. Creators can combine AI-assisted generation with their own expertise to deliver polished, high-quality experiences that are ready for real users and real traffic.

With Sticklight, creators can build complete applications - including dashboards, client portals, internal tools, MVPs, marketing platforms, and interactive products - not just static sites. The result is a stable, flexible environment where professionals can move from idea to fully functional application while maintaining the precision, reliability, and creative control their work requires.
plugin_asdk_app_69b17914fd508191bcd9d886.longDescriptionZh:
Sticklight 是一款人工智能驱动的构建器，专为想要更快地构建真正的数字产品的专业网络创建者而设计，同时又不影响质量、控制或设计标准。
您首先用自然语言描述您想要创建的内容，Sticklight 会生成一个工作项目，其中的结构、界面和核心逻辑已经就位。从那里，创建者可以完善每个细节 - 手动编辑元素、调整布局和交互，以及在需要时访问底层代码。这使得专业人员能够完全控制每个像素并保持其工作要求的工艺水平。

Sticklight 对于经验丰富的创作者来说尤其有价值，因为它能够产生非通用的结果。该平台不是模板化的输出，而是旨在支持定制设计决策和独特的产品创意，同时仍然加速构建过程。创作者可以将人工智能辅助生成与自己的专业知识相结合，提供精致、高质量的体验，为真实用户和真实流量做好准备。

借助 Sticklight，创建者可以构建完整的应用程序 - 包括仪表板、客户端门户、内部工具、MVP、营销平台和交互式产品 - 而不仅仅是静态网站。其结果是一个稳定、灵活的环境，专业人员可以从想法转向功能齐全的应用程序，同时保持工作所需的精确性、可靠性和创造性控制。

plugin_asdk_app_6a1cb1116f4881919bfa5e9a.name: Agent Ready
plugin_asdk_app_6a1cb1116f4881919bfa5e9a.productIntro: Agent Ready 检查任何网站对于 AI 代理、助手和爬虫的可读性。给它一个 URL，它会根据 Vercel 代理可读性规范、llms.txt 标准和新兴代理协议（MCP 服务器卡、A2A 代理卡、agents.json）扫描站点，然后呈现交互式记分卡：0-100 代理可读性分数、llms.txt 分数以及按站点、页面、llms.txt 和协议分组的每次检查细分 - 每个失败的检查都配有简单的英语修复。
plugin_asdk_app_6a1cb1116f4881919bfa5e9a.productIntroEn: Agent Ready checks how readable any website is to AI agents, assistants, and crawlers. Give it a URL and it scans the site against the Vercel Agent Readability Spec, the llms.txt standard, and emerging agent protocols (MCP server cards, A2A agent cards, agents.json), then renders an interactive score card: a 0–100 agent-readability score, an llms.
plugin_asdk_app_6a1cb1116f4881919bfa5e9a.longDescription:
Agent Ready checks how readable any website is to AI agents, assistants, and crawlers. Give it a URL and it scans the site against the Vercel Agent Readability Spec, the llms.txt standard, and emerging agent protocols (MCP server cards, A2A agent cards, agents.json), then renders an interactive score card: a 0–100 agent-readability score, an llms.txt score, and a per-check breakdown grouped by site, page, llms.txt, and protocol - each failing check paired with a plain-English fix.

Use it to find out why AI tools can't read your content, validate your llms.txt and AGENTS.md, confirm your structured data and Markdown mirrors, and re-scan any time to check that your fixes landed. Each result links to a full, shareable report on agent-ready.dev. Free to use, no account required.
plugin_asdk_app_6a1cb1116f4881919bfa5e9a.longDescriptionZh:
Agent Ready 检查任何网站对于 AI 代理、助手和爬虫的可读性。给它一个 URL，它会根据 Vercel 代理可读性规范、llms.txt 标准和新兴代理协议（MCP 服务器卡、A2A 代理卡、agents.json）扫描站点，然后呈现交互式记分卡：0-100 代理可读性分数、llms.txt 分数以及按站点、页面、llms.txt 和协议分组的每次检查细分 - 每个失败的检查都配有简单的英语修复。

使用它可以找出 AI 工具无法读取您的内容的原因，验证您的 llms.txt 和 AGENTS.md，确认您的结构化数据和 Markdown 镜像，并随时重新扫描以检查您的修复是否已完成。每个结果都链接到 agent-ready.dev 上完整的、可共享的报告。免费使用，无需帐户。

plugin_asdk_app_6a08dfd9b4948191b31c7f26.name: Olostep
plugin_asdk_app_6a08dfd9b4948191b31c7f26.productIntro: Olostep 将网络转化为人工智能的干净、结构化数据。使用自然语言搜索网络，将任何 URL 抓取到 Markdown、HTML、JSON 或屏幕截图中，抓取整个网站，并获得基于网络资源的人工智能答案。 Olostep 可靠、经济高效且可扩展至数十亿个请求，让您可以将实时 Web 数据直接提取到 ChatGPT 中，而无需管理浏览器、代理或抓取工具。
plugin_asdk_app_6a08dfd9b4948191b31c7f26.productIntroEn: Olostep turns the web into clean, structured data for AI. Search the web with natural language, scrape any URL into Markdown, HTML, JSON, or screenshots, crawl entire sites, and get AI-powered answers grounded in web sources.
plugin_asdk_app_6a08dfd9b4948191b31c7f26.longDescription: Olostep turns the web into clean, structured data for AI. Search the web with natural language, scrape any URL into Markdown, HTML, JSON, or screenshots, crawl entire sites, and get AI-powered answers grounded in web sources. plugin_asdk_app_6a3bbf2f5a1c8191bd7c43ab.productIntro: ArmorCodex 允许您阅读、更新和审查控制 AI 编码代理如何与工具、文件和基础设施交互的策略。使用自然语言设置规则（“拒绝 webfetch”、“需要批准生产数据库更改”）、检查当前策略状态并在工具调用运行之前注册意图计划。由 ArmorIQ 为需要对 AI 代理活动进行治理和审核的团队构建。

plugin_asdk_app_698641f6925c81918cbc124d.name: Botpress
plugin_asdk_app_698641f6925c81918cbc124d.description: 生产就绪的 AI 代理
plugin_asdk_app_698641f6925c81918cbc124d.productIntro: 完整的人工智能代理平台
plugin_asdk_app_698641f6925c81918cbc124d.longDescription:
The Complete AI Agent Platform

Botpress is an all-in-one platform for building AI agents powered by the latest LLMs. Use this application to rapidly prototype agents that can do FAQ, sales, support and so much more!

How it works:
1. Tag @Botpress in your chat and ask ChatGPT to create an agent with Botpress.
2. Iterate on design, business logic, information sources and more through natural language!
3. Once deployed, with the click of a button, you can open your agent in Botpress to access a comprehensive visual agent builder.
plugin_asdk_app_698641f6925c81918cbc124d.longDescriptionZh:
完整的人工智能代理平台

Botpress 是一个一体化平台，用于构建由最新法学硕士提供支持的人工智能代理。使用此应用程序快速建立可以执行常见问题解答、销售、支持等任务的代理原型！

工作原理：
1. 在聊天中标记 @Botpress，并要求 ChatGPT 使用 Botpress 创建代理。
2.通过自然语言迭代设计、业务逻辑、信息源等！
3. 部署后，只需单击按钮，您就可以在 Botpress 中打开代理以访问全面的可视化代理生成器。
defaultPrompts: create a bot
defaultPromptsZh: 创建一个机器人

plugin_asdk_app_6a70eca71e948191aea49dbb.productIntro: Context 将实时网络和文件转变为 ChatGPT 内干净的、可供代理使用的数据。搜索当前信息、以 Markdown 形式读取已知页面、抓取网站、提取模式形状的 JSON、解析文档、检索公司和品牌情报、检查视觉设计系统、跨数千个 URL 运行异步批量抓取，以及监控网站随时间的有意义的变化。一些抓取工具可以执行明确请求的浏览器操作来显示内容。 Context 不提供一般消息传递、日历、帐户管理或社交发布集成。

plugin_asdk_app_6a70eca71e948191aea49dbb.longDescription: Context turns the live web and files into clean, agent-ready data inside ChatGPT. Search for current information, read a known page as Markdown, crawl websites, extract schema-shaped JSON, parse documents, retrieve company and brand intelligence, inspect visual design systems, run asynchronous scraping batches across thousands of URLs, and monitor websites for meaningful changes over time. Some scraping tools can perform explicitly requested browser actions to reveal content. Context does not provide general messaging, calendar, account-management, or social-publishing integrations.
plugin_asdk_app_6a70eca71e948191aea49dbb.longDescriptionZh: Context 将实时网络和文件转变为 ChatGPT 内干净的、可供代理使用的数据。搜索当前信息、以 Markdown 形式读取已知页面、抓取网站、提取模式形状的 JSON、解析文档、检索公司和品牌情报、检查视觉设计系统、跨数千个 URL 运行异步批量抓取，以及监控网站随时间的有意义的变化。一些抓取工具可以执行明确请求的浏览器操作来显示内容。 Context 不提供一般消息传递、日历、帐户管理或社交发布集成。

plugin_asdk_app_6967f065ac9481918969c660.name: Statsig
plugin_asdk_app_6967f065ac9481918969c660.productIntro: 将您的 Statsig 工作区引入 Codex。产品构建者现在可以在 Codex 对话中直接探索、管理和创建 Statsig 实验、功能门、动态配置等。
plugin_asdk_app_6967f065ac9481918969c660.productIntroEn: Bring your Statsig workspace into Codex. Product builders can now explore, manage, and create Statsig experiments, feature gates, dynamic configs, and more directly in Codex conversations.
plugin_asdk_app_6967f065ac9481918969c660.longDescription:
Bring your Statsig workspace into Codex. Product builders can now explore, manage, and create Statsig experiments, feature gates, dynamic configs, and more directly in Codex conversations.

Ask things like:
“Move this experiment to 50% rollout.”
“Turn on this feature gate for all users.”
“Show me which dynamic configs changed this week.”
"Explain how the DAU metric is defined.”

You can both read and write to Statsig: inspect experiment settings, read metric definitions, update allocations, toggle feature flags, edit targeting rules, and modify dynamic config values directly from Codex.

The app connects through Statsig’s MCP server and honors your existing Statsig permissions, so you only see and change what you’re authorized to access—across projects, environments, and teams.
plugin_asdk_app_6967f065ac9481918969c660.longDescriptionZh:
将您的 Statsig 工作区引入 Codex。产品构建者现在可以在 Codex 对话中直接探索、管理和创建 Statsig 实验、功能门、动态配置等。

问一些事情，比如：
“将此实验的推广率提高到 50%。”
“为所有用户打开此功能门。”
“显示本周哪些动态配置发生了变化。”
“解释一下 DAU 指标是如何定义的。”

您可以读取和写入 Statsig：检查实验设置、读取指标定义、更新分配、切换功能标志、编辑定位规则以及直接从 Codex 修改动态配置值。

该应用程序通过 Statsig 的 MCP 服务器进行连接，并尊重您现有的 Statsig 权限，因此您只能跨项目、环境和团队查看和更改您有权访问的内容。

defaultPromptsZh: 分析 Statsig 实验的结果short_blog_titles

plugin_asdk_app_6a64c90329cc8191bedca18a.name: Themely Design+Style Generator
plugin_asdk_app_6a64c90329cc8191bedca18a.productIntro: 使用 AI 为应用程序、网站、仪表板、登陆页面等创建精美的设计主题。描述您想要什么，探索不同的视觉风格，并排比较想法，并在几秒钟内预览您的概念。无论您是从空白页开始还是刷新现有想法，该工具都可以帮助您快速发现设计方向，而无需高级设计技能。
plugin_asdk_app_6a64c90329cc8191bedca18a.productIntroEn: Create beautiful design themes for apps, websites, dashboards, landing pages, and more with AI. Describe what you want, explore different visual styles, compare ideas side by side, and preview your concepts in seconds. Whether you are starting from a blank page or refreshing an existing idea, this tool helps you quickly discover design directions without needing advanced design skills.
plugin_asdk_app_6a64c90329cc8191bedca18a.longDescription:
Create beautiful design themes for apps, websites, dashboards, landing pages, and more with AI. Describe what you want, explore different visual styles, compare ideas side by side, and preview your concepts in seconds. Whether you are starting from a blank page or refreshing an existing idea, this tool helps you quickly discover design directions without needing advanced design skills.

Simply tell ChatGPT what you want to build. You can ask for a mobile app, website, online store, portfolio, blog, dashboard, admin panel, marketing page, or almost any digital product. Then describe the feeling, audience, colors, or style you want. The AI turns your ideas into polished design themes that are easy to explore and refine.

Try many different looks without starting over. Generate clean, modern, minimal, playful, dark, colorful, premium, futuristic, glass, soft, bold, elegant, or creative themes. Compare different styles to find the one that best matches your project, brand, or personal taste. Small changes in your prompt can create fresh ideas that help you think in new ways.

Preview your ideas before spending time designing or building them. Seeing different themes early makes it easier to choose colors, layouts, typography, spacing, and overall visual direction. You can quickly decide what works and what does not before moving into design or development.

This tool is useful for designers, developers, founders, students, marketers, creators, agencies, and anyone who wants visual inspiration. It can help you explore ideas for business websites, startup landing pages, mobile apps, software dashboards, ecommerce stores, educational platforms, portfolios, travel sites, finance apps, health apps, productivity tools, entertainment services, and much more.

Use it when you need inspiration, want to overcome creative blocks, or simply want to see new possibilities. Generate many design directions in just a few moments instead of searching through endless galleries. Explore ideas that fit your goals and keep improving them until you find a style you love.

Experiment with color palettes, page layouts, interface styles, navigation, buttons, cards, forms, icons, sections, typography, and visual hierarchy. Ask for themes inspired by modern trends or timeless design principles. Mix different ideas together to create something unique for your own project.

The AI understands simple instructions, so you do not need special design words. Describe your project in everyday language. You can be detailed or brief. Ask for changes, request another style, or keep exploring until the result feels right. Every new prompt can lead to fresh concepts and unexpected ideas.

Whether you are planning your first website or improving a product used by thousands of people, this tool makes early design exploration faster and easier. It helps you discover themes, compare visual directions, and build confidence before investing time in detailed design work.

Perfect for brainstorming, creative exploration, product planning, design reviews, client presentations, prototypes, concept development, and visual inspiration. Turn simple ideas into attractive design themes, explore multiple possibilities, and find the look that best fits your project with the help of ChatGPT.
plugin_asdk_app_6a64c90329cc8191bedca18a.longDescriptionZh:
使用 AI 为应用程序、网站、仪表板、登陆页面等创建精美的设计主题。描述您想要什么，探索不同的视觉风格，并排比较想法，并在几秒钟内预览您的概念。无论您是从空白页开始还是刷新现有想法，该工具都可以帮助您快速发现设计方向，而无需高级设计技能。

只需告诉 ChatGPT 您想要构建什么即可。您可以索要移动应用程序、网站、在线商店、作品集、博客、仪表板、管理面板、营销页面或几乎任何数字产品。然后描述您想要的感觉、受众、颜色或风格。人工智能将您的想法转化为易于探索和完善的精美设计主题。

尝试多种不同的外观，无需重新开始。生成干净、现代、简约、俏皮、黑暗、多彩、优质、未来、玻璃、柔软、大胆、优雅或创意主题。比较不同的风格，找到最适合您的项目、品牌或个人品味的风格。提示中的微小变化可以产生新的想法，帮助您以新的方式思考。

在花时间设计或构建您的想法之前预览它们。尽早看到不同的主题可以更轻松地选择颜色、布局、排版、间距和整体视觉方向。在开始设计或开发之前，您可以快速决定哪些有效，哪些无效。

该工具对于设计师、开发人员、创始人、学生、营销人员、创作者、代理机构以及任何想要视觉灵感的人都很有用。它可以帮助您探索商业网站、初创企业登陆页面、移动应用程序、软件仪表板、电子商务商店、教育平台、投资组合、旅游网站、金融应用程序、健康应用程序、生产力工具、娱乐服务等的想法。

当您需要灵感、想要克服创意障碍或只是想看到新的可能性时，请使用它。只需几分钟即可生成许多设计方向，而不是在无尽的画廊中搜索。探索适合您目标的想法并不断改进它们，直到找到您喜欢的风格。

尝试调色板、页面布局、界面样式、导航、按钮、卡片、表单、图标、部分、版式和视觉层次结构。寻求受现代趋势或永恒设计原则启发的主题。将不同的想法混合在一起，为您自己的项目创造独特的东西。
人工智能可以理解简单的指令，因此您不需要特殊的设计语言。用日常语言描述您的项目。您可以详细或简短。要求改变，要求另一种风格，或者继续探索，直到结果合适为止。每一个新的提示都可能带来新的概念和意想不到的想法。

无论您是规划您的第一个网站还是改进成千上万人使用的产品，此工具都可以让早期设计探索变得更快、更轻松。它可以帮助您在投入时间进行详细设计工作之前发现主题、比较视觉方向并建立信心。

非常适合头脑风暴、创意探索、产品规划、设计评审、客户演示、原型、概念开发和视觉灵感。在 ChatGPT 的帮助下，将简单的想法变成有吸引力的设计主题，探索多种可能性，并找到最适合您项目的外观。

plugin_asdk_app_6a6f3e5f82a08191bc0493c6.name: 60fps
plugin_asdk_app_6a6f3e5f82a08191bc0493c6.description: 搜索真实的 iOS 交互
plugin_asdk_app_6a6f3e5f82a08191bc0493c6.productIntro: 60fps 是一个真实的 iOS 应用程序交互库，从发布的应用程序中记录下来并进行分解，以便 你可以建造它们。
plugin_asdk_app_6a6f3e5f82a08191bc0493c6.productIntroEn: 60fps is a library of real iOS app interactions, recorded from shipping apps and broken down so you can build them.
plugin_asdk_app_6a6f3e5f82a08191bc0493c6.longDescription:
60fps is a library of real iOS app interactions, recorded from shipping apps and broken down so
you can build them.

Search in plain language, like "springy bottom sheet" or "pull to refresh with haptics", and get
back matching shots with the app, the gesture, and the motion vocabulary that describes them. Open
one for a frame by frame breakdown of the animation: what moves, in what order, with what timing
and easing. Where a bespoke recreation exists, you can pull compile-checked SwiftUI for it.

It answers the question a reference video cannot: not just what an interaction looks like, but what
it is actually doing.

Read only. It never writes anything and never acts on your behalf.
plugin_asdk_app_6a6f3e5f82a08191bc0493c6.longDescriptionZh:
60fps 是一个真实的 iOS 应用程序交互库，从发布的应用程序中记录下来并进行分解，以便
你可以建造它们。

用简单的语言搜索，例如“弹性底片”或“用触觉拉动刷新”，然后得到
返回将镜头与应用程序、手势以及描述它们的动作词汇进行匹配。打开
动画的逐帧分解：什么移动、以什么顺序移动、在什么时间移动
和缓和。如果存在定制游戏，您可以为其提取经过编译检查的 SwiftUI。

它回答了参考视频无法回答的问题：不仅是交互看起来是什么样子，而且还回答了交互是什么
它实际上正在做。

只读。它从不写任何东西，也从不代表您行事。
defaultPrompts: Find a springy bottom sheet interaction and break down its motion
Show me how iOS apps do pull to refresh with haptics
Give me the SwiftUI for a card that expands into a full screen view
defaultPromptsZh: 找到弹性底部片相互作用并分解其运动
展示 iOS 应用如何通过触觉进行拉动刷新
给我一张可扩展为全屏视图的卡片的 SwiftUI

plugin_asdk_app_6a3a3eaae26081918ee32782.description: 将 Testif 连接到您的代理
plugin_asdk_app_6a3a3eaae26081918ee32782.productIntro: Testifly 可帮助开发人员、QA 工程师和产品团队直接从 URL 进行自动化端到端 (E2E) 测试、网站检查和 UI 验证来验证网站和 Web 应用程序。运行基于浏览器的测试来验证用户流、页面行为、重定向、可用性、性能、可访问性和整体站点运行状况，而无需任何设置。无论您是测试生产站点、临时环境、预览部署还是本地环境，Testifly 都能在问题到达用户之前快速识别问题。
plugin_asdk_app_6a3a3eaae26081918ee32782.productIntroEn: Testifly helps developers, QA engineers, and product teams validate websites and web applications with automated end-to-end (E2E) testing, website checks, and UI validation directly from a URL. Run browser-based tests to verify user flows, page behavior, redirects, availability, performance, accessibility, and overall site health without any setup.
plugin_asdk_app_6a3a3eaae26081918ee32782.longDescription:
Testifly helps developers, QA engineers, and product teams validate websites and web applications with automated end-to-end (E2E) testing, website checks, and UI validation directly from a URL. Run browser-based tests to verify user flows, page behavior, redirects, availability, performance, accessibility, and overall site health without any setup. Whether you're testing a production site, staging environment, preview deployment, or local environment, Testifly quickly identifies issues before they reach users.

Testifly is especially valuable for AI-assisted and vibe coding workflows, where code is generated rapidly by AI coding agents. As development accelerates, automated end-to-end validation is critical to ensure features actually work in the browser. Testifly provides an independent verification layer that catches broken user flows, regressions, UI issues, and deployment problems that AI-generated code or unit tests may miss.

Integrated with ChatGPT, Testifly lets you create, run, and analyze end-to-end tests using natural language. It works alongside AI development tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Windsurf, and other coding agents, enabling developers to verify changes continuously without writing test code. Generate structured test reports, validate bug fixes, monitor regressions, and confidently ship high-quality web applications.
plugin_asdk_app_6a3a3eaae26081918ee32782.longDescriptionZh:
Testifly 可帮助开发人员、QA 工程师和产品团队直接从 URL 进行自动化端到端 (E2E) 测试、网站检查和 UI 验证来验证网站和 Web 应用程序。运行基于浏览器的测试来验证用户流、页面行为、重定向、可用性、性能、可访问性和整体站点运行状况，而无需任何设置。无论您是测试生产站点、临时环境、预览部署还是本地环境，Testifly 都能在问题到达用户之前快速识别问题。

Testifly 对于人工智能辅助和氛围编码工作流程特别有价值，其中代码由人工智能编码代理快速生成。随着开发的加速，自动化的端到端验证对于确保功能在浏览器中实际运行至关重要。 Testifly 提供了一个独立的验证层，可以捕获人工智能生成的代码或单元测试可能遗漏的损坏的用户流程、回归、UI 问题和部署问题。

Testifly 与 ChatGPT 集成，让您可以使用自然语言创建、运行和分析端到端测试。它与 Claude Code、Cursor、GitHub Copilot、Windsurf 和其他编码代理等 AI 开发工具配合使用，使开发人员能够持续验证更改，而无需编写测试代码。生成结构化测试报告、验证错误修复、监控回归并自信地交付高质量的 Web 应用程序。

plugin_asdk_app_6a33ce728e488191a82df247.productIntro: Sugra API 是人工智能代理和决策平台的智能基础设施：跨域主要源数据的一种密钥和一种标准化格式，通过模型上下文协议呈现给代理。该连接器在包含 1,300 多个端点的完整 Sugra 目录中公开了一个小型、稳定的工具界面，聚合了跨数据领域的 130 多个主要来源，包括市场、宏观经济和中央银行、公司备案、公共金融、贸易流、农业、气候和自然事件、海事活动、预测市场、全球新闻、网络情报和实体筛选。
plugin_asdk_app_6a33ce728e488191a82df247.productIntroEn: Sugra API is intelligence infrastructure for AI agents and decision platforms: one key and one normalized format for cross-domain primary-source data, surfaced to agents through the Model Context Protocol.
plugin_asdk_app_6a33ce728e488191a82df247.longDescription: Sugra API is intelligence infrastructure for AI agents and decision platforms: one key and one normalized format for cross-domain primary-source data, surfaced to agents through the Model Context Protocol. The connector exposes a small, stable tool surface over the full Sugra catalog of more than 1,300 endpoints aggregating 130+ primary sources across data domains including markets, macroeconomics and central banks, corporate filings, public finance, trade flows, agriculture, climate and natural events, maritime activity, prediction markets, global news, network intelligence, and entity screening. Main workflows: discover endpoints by natural-language search and inspect their schemas, run a one-step find-and-call to retrieve data, pull macroeconomic series and central-bank rates, fetch market prices, history and fundamentals through Sugra Finance, screen a person or organization name against sanctions corpora, resolve free text to a canonical entity, and compose a normalized current view or bounded timeseries for an entity with freshness and provenance. Works with Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, and xAI model families and any MCP-enabled client. A free Sugra account is the only connection requirement; the read-only surface never writes, deletes, sends, or publishes.
plugin_asdk_app_6a33ce728e488191a82df247.longDescriptionZh: Sugra API 是人工智能代理和决策平台的智能基础设施：跨域主要源数据的一种密钥和一种标准化格式，通过模型上下文协议呈现给代理。该连接器在包含 1,300 多个端点的完整 Sugra 目录中公开了一个小型、稳定的工具界面，聚合了跨数据领域的 130 多个主要来源，包括市场、宏观经济和中央银行、公司备案、公共金融、贸易流、农业、气候和自然事件、海事活动、预测市场、全球新闻、网络情报和实体筛选。主要工作流程：通过自然语言搜索发现端点并检查其模式，运行一步查找和调用来检索数据，拉动宏观经济序列和央行利率，通过 Sugra Finance 获取市场价格、历史和基本面，根据制裁语料库筛选个人或组织名称，将自由文本解析为规范实体，并为具有新鲜度和出处的实体构建规范化的当前视图或有界时间序列。适用于 Anthropic、OpenAI、Google 和 xAI 模型系列以及任何支持 MCP 的客户端。免费的 Sugra 帐户是唯一的连接要求；只读表面永远不会写入、删除、发送或发布。

plugin_asdk_app_6a60e68db3908191b0af3727.name: MiroMiro
plugin_asdk_app_6a60e68db3908191b0af3727.longDescription:
Extract design from any website

MiroMiro lets you pull real design data out of any live website from ChatGPT: brand colors, fonts, logos, design tokens, images, SVGs, and Lottie animations, plus production-ready code rebuilt from actual page sections. Everything comes from the site's real CSS and assets, not screenshots or guesses.

Use it to match a brand, rebuild a section you like, or collect assets for a moodboard, then drop the output straight into your project.

What you can do:

-Extract a complete brand profile from any URL: color palette with roles, fonts, logo and favicon URLs, social profiles, and theme
-Pull a site's design token system (colors, spacing, radii, shadows, typography) as CSS variables or a Tailwind config
-Turn any page section into clean React, Vue, or HTML with Tailwind classes
-List every font a site loads with file URLs, formats, and the CSS stack to replicate it
-Collect all SVG logos and icons as paste-ready code and direct file URLs
-Gather a page's image assets grouped by source (img, srcset, picture, background, favicon, social image) with direct URLs
-Find Lottie animations on a page and get their JSON files

Best for developers, designers, and AI builders who need real design data from live sites instead of eyeballing it.
plugin_asdk_app_6a60e68db3908191b0af3727.longDescriptionZh:
从任何网站提取设计

MiroMiro 可让您从 ChatGPT 的任何实时网站中提取真实的设计数据：品牌颜色、字体、徽标、设计令牌、图像、SVG 和 Lottie 动画，以及从实际页面部分重建的生产就绪代码。一切都来自网站的真实 CSS 和资源，而不是屏幕截图或猜测。

使用它来匹配品牌、重建您喜欢的部分或收集情绪板的资源，然后将输出直接放入您的项目中。

你可以做什么：

-从任何 URL 中提取完整的品牌资料：包含角色、字体、徽标和网站图标 URL、社交资料和主题的调色板
- 将站点的设计标记系统（颜色、间距、半径、阴影、版式）拉为 CSS 变量或 Tailwind 配置
- 使用 Tailwind 类将任何页面部分转换为干净的 React、Vue 或 HTML
-列出网站加载的每种字体以及文件 URL、格式和用于复制它的 CSS 堆栈
- 收集所有 SVG 徽标和图标作为可粘贴代码和直接文件 URL
- 使用直接 URL 收集按源（img、srcset、图片、背景、favicon、社交图像）分组的页面图像资源
- 在页面上查找 Lottie 动画并获取其 JSON 文件

最适合需要来自现场站点的真实设计数据而不是目测数据的开发人员、设计师和人工智能构建者。

plugin_asdk_app_69932d93c9088191a2574842.productIntroEn: microfn is a sandboxed cloud environment for building, deploying, and running tiny JavaScript functions - designed to be AI-friendly. Give ChatGPT its own workspace to write functions, deploy them, manage their code and secrets, and run the functions you've already built.
plugin_asdk_app_69932d93c9088191a2574842.longDescription:
microfn is a sandboxed cloud environment for building, deploying, and running tiny JavaScript functions - designed to be AI-friendly. Give ChatGPT its own workspace to write functions, deploy them, manage their code and secrets, and run the functions you've already built.

With microfn, ChatGPT can:

- Write and deploy a new JavaScript function on request
- Inspect, update, and validate the code of existing functions
- Manage function settings and secrets securely
- Run your functions and use their results in the conversation

Each function runs in an isolated sandbox, so ChatGPT can safely create and compose its own tools - fetch a weather API, build a key-value store, post to Slack, send a Telegram message, and much more.
plugin_asdk_app_69932d93c9088191a2574842.longDescriptionZh:
microfn 是一个沙盒云环境，用于构建、部署和运行小型 JavaScript 函数 - 旨在对 AI 友好。为 ChatGPT 提供自己的工作区来编写函数、部署它们、管理它们的代码和机密，以及运行您已经构建的函数。

借助 microfn，ChatGPT 可以：

- 根据要求编写和部署新的 JavaScript 函数
- 检查、更新和验证现有函数的代码
- 安全地管理功能设置和机密
- 运行您的函数并在对话中使用它们的结果

每个函数都在隔离的沙箱中运行，因此 ChatGPT 可以安全地创建和编写自己的工具 - 获取天气 API、构建键值存储、发布到 Slack、发送 Telegram 消息等等。

plugin_asdk_app_6a11f8d088cc8191b6b6abf3.name: Git Diff Patcher Bridge
plugin_asdk_app_6a11f8d088cc8191b6b6abf3.description: 安全地审查 AI 代码补丁
plugin_asdk_app_6a11f8d088cc8191b6b6abf3.productIntro: Git Diff Patcher Bridge 将 ChatGPT 连接到本地 GDP 桌面会话或种子演示工作区。 ChatGPT 可以检查存储库上下文、读取允许的文件、搜索文本、使用 Patch Doctor 诊断统一差异，以及对补丁提案进行排队以供本地审核。桥接器从不自行应用、提交、推送、重置、清理、删除、回滚或运行终端命令。所有存储库更改操作均在 GDP Desktop 内的用户控制之下。
plugin_asdk_app_6a11f8d088cc8191b6b6abf3.productIntroEn: Git Diff Patcher Bridge connects ChatGPT to a local GDP Desktop session or a seeded Demo Workspace. ChatGPT can inspect repository context, read allowed files, search text, diagnose unified diffs with Patch Doctor, and queue patch proposals for local review. The bridge never applies, commits, pushes, resets, cleans, deletes, rolls back, or runs terminal commands on its own.
plugin_asdk_app_6a11f8d088cc8191b6b6abf3.longDescription: Git Diff Patcher Bridge connects ChatGPT to a local GDP Desktop session or a seeded Demo Workspace. ChatGPT can inspect repository context, read allowed files, search text, diagnose unified diffs with Patch Doctor, and queue patch proposals for local review. The bridge never applies, commits, pushes, resets, cleans, deletes, rolls back, or runs terminal commands on its own. All repository-changing actions remain under the user’s control inside GDP Desktop.
plugin_asdk_app_6a11f8d088cc8191b6b6abf3.longDescriptionZh: Git Diff Patcher Bridge 将 ChatGPT 连接到本地 GDP 桌面会话或种子演示工作区。 ChatGPT 可以检查存储库上下文、读取允许的文件、搜索文本、使用 Patch Doctor 诊断统一差异，以及对补丁提案进行排队以供本地审核。桥接器从不自行应用、提交、推送、重置、清理、删除、回滚或运行终端命令。所有存储库更改操作均在 GDP Desktop 内的用户控制之下。

plugin_asdk_app_6a6d31df2f848191acf2daa6.productIntro: Sitelemetry 对网站进行安全性、技术 SEO、AI 可见性、分析和跟踪集成、可访问性和性能方面的审核。它返回带有证据、影响和具体补救指导的优先发现结果。公开的、非侵入性的检查可以评估公共网站；受保护的安全模块和全面审核需要经过验证的 Sitelemetry 项目。连接使用带有 PKCE 的 OAuth，并且私有网络目标被阻止。需要 Sitelemetry 帐户；可用的审核和使用限制反映了已分配给连接帐户的访问权限。
plugin_asdk_app_6a6d31df2f848191acf2daa6.productIntroEn: Sitelemetry audits websites across security, technical SEO, AI visibility, analytics and tracking integrations, accessibility, and performance. It returns prioritized findings with evidence, impact, and concrete remediation guidance. Public, non-intrusive checks can assess public websites; protected security modules and full audits require a verified Sitelemetry project.
plugin_asdk_app_6a6d31df2f848191acf2daa6.longDescription: Sitelemetry audits websites across security, technical SEO, AI visibility, analytics and tracking integrations, accessibility, and performance. It returns prioritized findings with evidence, impact, and concrete remediation guidance. Public, non-intrusive checks can assess public websites; protected security modules and full audits require a verified Sitelemetry project. Connections use OAuth with PKCE, and private-network targets are blocked. A Sitelemetry account is required; available audits and usage limits reflect the access already assigned to the connected account.
plugin_asdk_app_6a6d31df2f848191acf2daa6.longDescriptionZh: Sitelemetry 对网站进行安全性、技术 SEO、AI 可见性、分析和跟踪集成、可访问性和性能方面的审核。它返回带有证据、影响和具体补救指导的优先发现结果。公开的、非侵入性的检查可以评估公共网站；受保护的安全模块和全面审核需要经过验证的 Sitelemetry 项目。连接使用带有 PKCE 的 OAuth，并且私有网络目标被阻止。需要 Sitelemetry 帐户；可用的审核和使用限制反映了已分配给连接帐户的访问权限。

plugin_asdk_app_698da77dd2f48191ba19e15b.name: Garchi CMS
plugin_asdk_app_698da77dd2f48191ba19e15b.description: 用于管理内容的 MCP 服务器
plugin_asdk_app_698da77dd2f48191ba19e15b.productIntro: Garchi CMS 是一种无头 SaaS CMS，用于跨平台（例如网站和应用程序）管理内容。借助此应用程序，您可以使用 MCP 服务器连接到 Garchi CMS，并利用 Chat GPT 的功能管理平台的内容。
plugin_asdk_app_698da77dd2f48191ba19e15b.productIntroEn: Garchi CMS is a headless SaaS CMS used to manage content across platforms such as websites and apps. With this app, you could connect to Garchi CMS using the MCP server and manage your platform's content levaraging the power of Chat GPT.
plugin_asdk_app_698da77dd2f48191ba19e15b.longDescription:
Garchi CMS is a headless SaaS CMS used to manage content across platforms such as websites and apps. With this app, you could connect to Garchi CMS using the MCP server and manage your platform's content levaraging the power of Chat GPT.

Example prompts
- Create a blog article on best principles of Gen AI using Garchi CMS
- Create a landing page using the provided brief in Garchi CMS.
plugin_asdk_app_698da77dd2f48191ba19e15b.longDescriptionZh:
Garchi CMS 是一种无头 SaaS CMS，用于跨平台（例如网站和应用程序）管理内容。借助此应用程序，您可以使用 MCP 服务器连接到 Garchi CMS，并利用 Chat GPT 的功能管理平台的内容。

提示示例

plugin_asdk_app_6a2b771cfb288191a4e53af3.productIntro: Mnemom 是为代理构建的信任基础设施，而不仅仅是为运行它们的人构建的。在一次聊天中，您可以查找代理的持续信任评级（分数、等级及其背后的责任证据），并确认它是经过加密签名的，而不仅仅是断言的。放下您自己的校准卡并立即获得信任回读；声明可验证的身份，且无人参与；并在您的自述文件或代理卡上获得可嵌入的信任评级徽章。每一次阅读都诚实地表达了它所知道的内容：安静的记录读起来就像安静的，永远不会像危险信号一样。系统说的是事实——查看源代码也证明了这一点。
plugin_asdk_app_6a2b771cfb288191a4e53af3.productIntroEn: Mnemom is trust infrastructure built for agents, not just the humans who run them. In one chat you can look up an agent's Continuous Trust Rating — the score, the grade, and the accountability evidence behind it — and confirm it's cryptographically signed, not merely asserted.
plugin_asdk_app_6a2b771cfb288191a4e53af3.longDescription: Mnemom is trust infrastructure built for agents, not just the humans who run them. In one chat you can look up an agent's Continuous Trust Rating — the score, the grade, and the accountability evidence behind it — and confirm it's cryptographically signed, not merely asserted. Drop your own alignment card and get an instant trust read back; claim a verifiable identity with no human in the loop; and walk away with an embeddable Trust Rating badge for your README or agent card. Every read is honest about what it knows: a quiet record reads as quiet, never as a red flag. The system tells the truth — and view-source proves it.

plugin_asdk_app_6a5a7c2760248191a8c61bb2.name: Graffiticode
plugin_asdk_app_6a5a7c2760248191a8c61bb2.productIntro: Graffiticode 让 AI 代理执行经过验证的特定于任务的操作，而不是进行不受限制的 API 调用。通过使用正式的任务语言来验证输入、实施功能并生成结构化工件，Graffiticode 帮助开发人员将其服务公开给 AI 代理，并提供更好的控制、可靠性和可预测的结果。
plugin_asdk_app_6a5a7c2760248191a8c61bb2.productIntroEn: Graffiticode lets AI agents perform verified, task-specific operations instead of making unrestricted API calls. By using formal task languages to validate inputs, enforce capabilities, and produce structured artifacts, Graffiticode helps developers expose their services to AI agents with greater control, reliability, and predictable results.
plugin_asdk_app_6a5a7c2760248191a8c61bb2.longDescription:
Graffiticode lets AI agents perform verified, task-specific operations instead of making unrestricted API calls. By using formal task languages to validate inputs, enforce capabilities, and produce structured artifacts, Graffiticode helps developers expose their services to AI agents with greater control, reliability, and predictable results.

Explore the growing catalog of Graffiticode languages for common tasks, or create your own language to expose your application's unique capabilities to AI agents through a verified, task-specific interface.
plugin_asdk_app_6a5a7c2760248191a8c61bb2.longDescriptionZh:
Graffiticode 让 AI 代理执行经过验证的特定于任务的操作，而不是进行不受限制的 API 调用。通过使用正式的任务语言来验证输入、实施功能并生成结构化工件，Graffiticode 帮助开发人员将其服务公开给 AI 代理，并提供更好的控制、可靠性和可预测的结果。

探索用于常见任务的不断增长的 Graffiticode 语言目录，或创建您自己的语言，通过经过验证的特定于任务的界面向 AI 代理展示您的应用程序的独特功能。

plugin_asdk_app_6a724310c3308191806a4471.name: NORMS: Evidence & Scope
plugin_asdk_app_6a724310c3308191806a4471.productIntro: NORMS 评估结构化的、经批准的规范性记录对于所声明的目的是否有足够的经过验证的依据。它检查明确的权限、时间适用性、范围、验证、规定分段和结构化条件，然后报告阻碍因素、未知因素和未经检查的领域。缺少或未经验证的所需理由无法关闭。 NORMS 不提供法律建议、证明合规性、解析 PDF 或文档、检索法律、从自由文本推断规范条件、批准合同或修改外部数据。
plugin_asdk_app_6a724310c3308191806a4471.productIntroEn: NORMS assesses whether structured, ratified normative records have sufficient verified grounds for a declared purpose. It checks explicit authority, temporal applicability, scope, verification, provision segmentation and structured conditions, then reports blockers, unknowns and unexamined areas. Missing or unverified required grounds fail closed.
plugin_asdk_app_6a724310c3308191806a4471.longDescription: NORMS assesses whether structured, ratified normative records have sufficient verified grounds for a declared purpose. It checks explicit authority, temporal applicability, scope, verification, provision segmentation and structured conditions, then reports blockers, unknowns and unexamined areas. Missing or unverified required grounds fail closed. NORMS does not provide legal advice, certify compliance, parse PDFs or documents, retrieve laws, infer normative conditions from free text, approve contracts or modify external data.

plugin_asdk_app_6a79de2b746881918127ddf4.longDescription:
Nimble gives agents governed, accurate access to the public web, at a lower token cost per answer. Search finds current pages with ranked results and snippets. plugin_asdk_app_6a6f945292888191a7d77db4.name: @imqueue
plugin_asdk_app_6a6f945292888191a7d77db4.productIntro: @imqueue 是一个开源 TypeScript 框架，用于构建微服务 通过消息队列而不是 HTTP 进行对话 — 您编写一个类，装饰 您想要发布的方法，并且调用者获得从生成的完全类型的客户端 正在运行的服务。
plugin_asdk_app_6a6f945292888191a7d77db4.productIntroEn: @imqueue is an open-source TypeScript framework for building microservices that talk over a message queue instead of HTTP — you write a class, decorate the methods you want to publish, and callers get a fully-typed client generated from the running service.
plugin_asdk_app_6a6f945292888191a7d77db4.longDescription:
@imqueue is an open-source TypeScript framework for building microservices that
talk over a message queue instead of HTTP — you write a class, decorate the
methods you want to publish, and callers get a fully-typed client generated from
the running service.

This server gives your assistant first-hand knowledge of it, so it writes real
@imqueue code instead of plausible-looking code.

search_docs covers the guides, the tutorial, the CLI manual, the articles, and
every exported symbol of every @imqueue package that publishes an API reference —
so you can ask a question in plain words ("how do I expose a service method?") or
look up an exact signature ("RedisQueue.send", "IMQOptions.safeDelivery").
Results carry page URLs, and get_doc returns any page as plain markdown for
reading and quoting. list_packages returns the current package catalogue with
install commands, which is how an assistant picks the right one rather than
guessing at a name. Where two packages cover the same ground — tracing, or the
database layer — the results carry the rule for choosing exactly one, because
installing both breaks quietly rather than loudly.

scaffold_service generates an idiomatic service — an IMQService subclass with
@expose()d, JSDoc-typed methods plus a bootstrap that starts it — from the method
signatures you describe. A custom return type comes back with the @classType() and
@property() decorators it needs, which matters because a field that lacks them
reaches the generated client typed any and still compiles. scaffold_client shows
how to generate and use the typed client for a service. Both return source text
for you to review and paste; neither writes a file.

All six tools are read-only. The server has no accounts, no authentication and no
storage: each request is handled statelessly, and the only data it sees is the
argument you send — a search query, a doc URL, a service name. Nothing is
retained, and no conversation content is collected or used for training.

Tools that would act on your own machine — driving the imq CLI, creating projects
on disk, starting and stopping your services, reading their logs — are
deliberately not part of this server, because a hosted server cannot reach your
machine and should not claim to. They ship in the local install instead
(npx -y @imqueue/mcp), and local_install_guide returns the setup steps for it.

plugin_asdk_app_6a5bf18abfcc819184d18840.name: SiteTriage
plugin_asdk_app_6a5bf18abfcc819184d18840.originalDescription: Find out why a site is broken
plugin_asdk_app_6a5bf18abfcc819184d18840.productIntro: 您的网站刚刚崩溃 - 请询问 SiteTriage 为什么。给它一个 URL 或域，它就会从边缘运行实时只读诊断：DNS 解析和传播、服务器当前提供的确切 TLS 证书（包括 TLS 1.3）、HTTP 状态和重定向链、电子邮件身份验证（SPF、DKIM、DMARC）以及域注册和过期。然后，它会返回最可能的根本原因（按排名）以及具体的修复步骤，而不是猜测。
plugin_asdk_app_6a5bf18abfcc819184d18840.productIntroEn: Your site just broke — ask SiteTriage why. Give it a URL or domain and it runs live, read-only diagnostics from the edge: DNS resolution and propagation, the exact TLS certificate the server is presenting right now (including TLS 1.3), HTTP status and redirect chains, email authentication (SPF, DKIM, DMARC), and domain registration and expiry.
plugin_asdk_app_6a5bf18abfcc819184d18840.longDescription: Your site just broke — ask SiteTriage why. Give it a URL or domain and it runs live, read-only diagnostics from the edge: DNS resolution and propagation, the exact TLS certificate the server is presenting right now (including TLS 1.3), HTTP status and redirect chains, email authentication (SPF, DKIM, DMARC), and domain registration and expiry. It then returns the most likely root cause, ranked, with concrete fix steps — instead of guesses. Ideal for the deploy moment: apex-vs-www misconfigurations, stale DNS after a host migration, propagation lag, certificate errors, redirect loops, and emails landing in spam. Stateless and anonymous: no accounts, no stored data.
plugin_asdk_app_6a5bf18abfcc819184d18840.longDescriptionZh: 您的网站刚刚崩溃 - 请询问 SiteTriage 为什么。给它一个 URL 或域，它就会从边缘运行实时只读诊断：DNS 解析和传播、服务器当前提供的确切 TLS 证书（包括 TLS 1.3）、HTTP 状态和重定向链、电子邮件身份验证（SPF、DKIM、DMARC）以及域注册和过期。然后，它会返回最可能的根本原因（按排名）以及具体的修复步骤，而不是猜测。非常适合部署时刻：apex-vs-www 配置错误、主机迁移后过时的 DNS、传播滞后、证书错误、重定向循环以及垃圾邮件中的电子邮件。无状态和匿名：没有帐户，没有存储的数据。

plugin_asdk_app_6a651de7b82c8191bc3480f1.name: Opscotch
plugin_asdk_app_6a651de7b82c8191bc3480f1.productIntro: Opscotch MCP 服务器使人工智能助手能够直接访问 Opscotch 知识和创作工具。
plugin_asdk_app_6a651de7b82c8191bc3480f1.productIntroEn: The Opscotch MCP Server gives AI assistants direct access to Opscotch knowledge and authoring tools.
plugin_asdk_app_6a651de7b82c8191bc3480f1.longDescription:
The Opscotch MCP Server gives AI assistants direct access to Opscotch knowledge and authoring tools.

The MCP server exposes structured tools that allow AI assistants to understand, author, validate, and work with Opscotch applications and workflows.

The server is designed for developers using AI coding assistants, and automation engineers who want to build or maintain Opscotch solutions using natural language.

An AI connected to the server can perform tasks such as:
- answer questions about the Opscotch platform
- explain APIs, configuration, and runtime behaviour
- author workflows and bootstrap configurations
- validate workflow structure and configuration
- assist with packaging, deployment, and licensing
- provide guidance using the latest platform capabilities
- generate examples and implementation patterns

With MCP, the AI can use purpose-built tools that understand the Opscotch platform, resulting in responses that are:

- more accurate
- aware of current platform features
- capable of structured authoring rather than just producing text
- less prone to hallucinating APIs or configuration

Typical use cases
- "Create a workflow that polls an HTTP endpoint every minute."
- "Why won't this bootstrap validate?"
- "Generate a workflow that receives webhooks and forwards them to AWS SQS."
- "Explain this JavaScript processor."
- "Help migrate this workflow to the latest Opscotch version."
- "Help me generate a signed package for deployment."

The server is intended for:

- AI coding assistants
- IDE integrations
- CLI agents
- automation developers
- DevOps and platform engineers
- custom AI applications that need authoritative knowledge of Opscotch
plugin_asdk_app_6a651de7b82c8191bc3480f1.longDescriptionZh:
Opscotch MCP 服务器使人工智能助手能够直接访问 Opscotch 知识和创作工具。

MCP 服务器公开了结构化工具，允许 AI 助手理解、编写、验证和使用 Opscotch 应用程序和工作流程。

该服务器专为使用 AI 编码助手的开发人员以及想要使用自然语言构建或维护 Opscotch 解决方案的自动化工程师而设计。

连接到服务器的 AI 可以执行以下任务：
- 回答有关 Opscotch 平台的问题
- 解释 API、配置和运行时行为
- 作者工作流程和引导配置
- 验证工作流程结构和配置
- 协助打包、部署和许可
- 提供使用最新平台功能的指导
- 生成示例和实施模式

借助 MCP，AI 可以使用了解 Opscotch 平台的专用工具，从而产生以下响应：

- 更准确
- 了解当前平台功能
- 能够进行结构化创作而不仅仅是生成文本
- 不太容易产生幻觉 API 或配置

典型用例
- “创建一个每分钟轮询 HTTP 端点的工作流程。”
- “为什么这个引导程序无法验证？”
- “生成一个接收 Webhook 并将其转发到 AWS SQS 的工作流程。”
- “解释一下这个 JavaScript 处理器。”
- “帮助将此工作流程迁移到最新的 Opscotch 版本。”
- “帮我生成一个用于部署的签名包。”

该服务器适用于：

- AI编码助手
- IDE集成
- CLI 代理
- 自动化开发人员
- DevOps 和平台工程师
- 需要 Opscotch 权威知识的定制 AI 应用

plugin_asdk_app_6a48cb6545e4819192d92ee3.productIntro: Prism 读取您的实时 Crossdeck 工作区 - 收入、权利、错误、分析、读取成本和客户身份 - 通过 IDENTITY 连接，因此它可以回答单层工具无法解决的跨层问题：哪些付费客户遇到了错误以及他们支付了什么费用，谁在数据库读取中花费最多，以及您的终生价值排行榜的名称。安全且只读：OAuth 2.0 登录（无需粘贴密钥），无写入路径，并且每个数字都是自描述的（它报告“未检测”，而不是未连接表面的假零）。
plugin_asdk_app_6a48cb6545e4819192d92ee3.productIntroEn: Prism reads your live Crossdeck workspace — revenue, entitlements, errors, analytics, read-cost and customer identity — joined BY IDENTITY, so it answers cross-layer questions no single-layer tool can: which paying customers an error hit and what they pay, who costs the most in database reads, and your lifetime-value leaderboard by name. Secure and read-only: OAuth 2.

Agents can view, reply to, upvote, and verify posts created by other agents.  Is your agent stuck on a technical problem?  It can ask a question on Stack Overflow For Agents and see if other agents can solve the problem.
plugin_asdk_app_6a7f2f8bd57081919ffc6623.longDescriptionZh: Stack Overflow for Agents 提供免费、可信、经过生产测试的知识，因此您的代理可以花费更少的时间和更少的令牌来重新发现答案。  客服人员可以查看、回复、点赞和验证其他客服人员创建的帖子。  您的代理是否遇到技术问题？  它可以在 Stack Overflow For Agents 上提问，看看其他代理是否可以解决该问题。

plugin_asdk_app_6a7f2f8bd57081919ffc6623.productIntroEn: Stack Overflow For Agents is a service that helps you knowledge exchange for agents. In Codex, it is most useful when a task needs the service’s information or actions to be combined with reasoning, files, or other tools.

plugin_asdk_app_6a84930f6168819198fa552e.productIntroEn: Connect DocRunic to ChatGPT to work with documentation in your authorized workspaces. Search and browse pages, read current content and version history, inspect page structures and attachment metadata, create or update drafts, and publish documentation when requested.
plugin_asdk_app_6a84930f6168819198fa552e.longDescription:
Connect DocRunic to ChatGPT to work with documentation in your authorized workspaces. Search and browse pages, read current content and version history, inspect page structures and attachment metadata, create or update drafts, and publish documentation when requested.

Access is protected by DocRunic OAuth and follows the workspace access, role, and scopes granted to the connection. The plugin does not expose tools for deleting or archiving pages.
plugin_asdk_app_6a84930f6168819198fa552e.longDescriptionZh:
将 DocRunic 连接到 ChatGPT 以处理您授权工作区中的文档。搜索和浏览页面，阅读当前内容和版本历史记录，检查页面结构和附件元数据，创建或更新草稿，并根据要求发布文档。

访问受 DocRunic OAuth 保护，并遵循授予连接的工作区访问权限、角色和范围。该插件不公开用于删除或存档页面的工具。

plugin_asdk_app_6a3da23321a88191914164e9.name: Resolve AI
plugin_asdk_app_6a3da23321a88191914164e9.productIntro: 连接 ChatGPT 和 Codex 以解决 AI。启动并引导调查，拉取实时生产环境，并将根本原因调查结果转化为拉取请求。 Resolve 插件通过 MCP 连接 ChatGPT 和 Codex 以解决 AI。 Resolve 的客服人员会加入您的待命轮班，对警报进行分类和调查，并与工程师一起工作，更快地找到根本原因；该插件将该表面直接带入您的编码代理中，以便您可以在已经编码的地方对其进行操作。
plugin_asdk_app_6a3da23321a88191914164e9.productIntroEn: Connect ChatGPT and Codex to Resolve AI. Start and steer investigations, pull live production context, and turn root-cause findings into pull requests. The Resolve plugin connects ChatGPT and Codex to Resolve AI over MCP.
plugin_asdk_app_6a3da23321a88191914164e9.longDescription:
Connect ChatGPT and Codex to Resolve AI. Start and steer investigations, pull live production context, and turn root-cause findings into pull requests.
The Resolve plugin connects ChatGPT and Codex to Resolve AI over MCP. Resolve's agents join your on-call rotations to triage and investigate alerts and work alongside engineers to reach root cause faster; this plugin brings that surface directly into your coding agent so you can act on it where you already code.
It installs skills for listing and filtering alerts, reading and summarizing investigations, starting new root-cause analyses, asking follow-up questions, steering an active investigation with context you have locally, pulling an area's production profile before a risky change, and translating findings into local code changes and a PR.
plugin_asdk_app_6a3da23321a88191914164e9.longDescriptionZh:
连接 ChatGPT 和 Codex 以解决 AI。启动并引导调查，拉取实时生产环境，并将根本原因调查结果转化为拉取请求。
Resolve 插件通过 MCP 连接 ChatGPT 和 Codex 以解决 AI。 Resolve 的客服人员会加入您的待命轮班，对警报进行分类和调查，并与工程师一起工作，更快地找到根本原因；该插件将该表面直接带入您的编码代理中，以便您可以在已经编码的地方对其进行操作。
它安装了列出和过滤警报、阅读和总结调查、开始新的根本原因分析、提出后续问题、根据本地背景进行主动调查、在危险变更之前提取区域生产概况以及将调查结果转化为本地代码变更和 PR 等技能。

plugin_asdk_app_6a55753d6e00819194e26545.description: 为您的 AI 提供共享内存
plugin_asdk_app_6a55753d6e00819194e26545.productIntro: Cortex 为 ChatGPT 提供了持久的记忆，可以在对话中保存下来。保存决策和注释，按含义搜索它们，并综合回忆某个主题的已知内容 - 始终具有可追溯的来源。当新信息与您保存的信息相矛盾时，Cortex 会标记冲突，而不是默默地覆盖它。您的数据仍然绑定到您自己的订阅帐户。 SKYNETLAB 产品，受专利保护并已投入生产。
plugin_asdk_app_6a55753d6e00819194e26545.productIntroEn: Cortex gives ChatGPT a durable memory that survives across conversations. Save decisions and notes, search them by meaning, and get a synthesized recall of what's known on a topic — always with traceable sources. When new information contradicts what you saved, Cortex flags the conflict instead of silently overwriting it. Your data stays bound to your own subscription account.

plugin_asdk_app_6a6a699e6f3481918d5e6034.name: NPMScan
plugin_asdk_app_6a6a699e6f3481918d5e6034.productIntro: 直接从对话中查找 npm 包元数据、已知漏洞和 CVE 详细信息。 NPMScan 的 MCP 服务器为 AI 代理提供了七个由 npm 注册表、OSV.dev、GitHub 安全公告和 NIST 国家漏洞数据库支持的只读工具：按名称或关键字搜索包，并包含下载计数、依赖包计数以及每个结果的误植检测；安装前检查软件包的安装脚本、维护者​​、许可证、GitHub 星星和下载趋势；检查锁定文件中固定的确切版本；查询一个软件包的漏洞或一次最多查询 100 个漏洞，…
plugin_asdk_app_6a6a699e6f3481918d5e6034.productIntroEn: Look up npm package metadata, known vulnerabilities, and CVE details directly from a conversation. NPMScan's MCP server gives AI agents seven read-only tools backed by the npm registry, OSV.dev, GitHub Security Advisories, and the NIST National Vulnerability Database: search packages by name or keyword with download counts, dependent-package counts, and typosquat detection on every resul…
plugin_asdk_app_6a6a699e6f3481918d5e6034.longDescription: Look up npm package metadata, known vulnerabilities, and CVE details directly from a conversation. NPMScan's MCP server gives AI agents seven read-only tools backed by the npm registry, OSV.dev, GitHub Security Advisories, and the NIST National Vulnerability Database: search packages by name or keyword with download counts, dependent-package counts, and typosquat detection on every result; inspect a package's install scripts, maintainers, license, GitHub stars, and download trend before installing; check an exact version pinned in a lockfile; query vulnerabilities for one package or up to 100 at once, each finding enriched with severity, a summary, CVE aliases, and the fixed version rather than a bare advisory ID; browse the latest reviewed npm advisories, filterable by severity, vulnerability category (XSS, SQL/NoSQL Injection, SSRF, Access Control, Code Injection, and 15 more), affected package, or an exact GHSA/CVE ID; and look up authoritative CVSS/CWE data for any CVE across any ecosystem, enriched with CISA's Known Exploited Vulnerabilities status and FIRST.org's EPSS exploitation-probability score. No API key or authentication is required, and every result links back to the full write-up on npmscan.com.

plugin_asdk_app_6a7c58a845f88191860e59f4.productIntro: BasicDeploy 可让您的助手为 Web 应用程序创建实时容器、向其部署代码并对其进行管理 — 所有这些都可以通过聊天进行。每个应用程序都附带自动设置的 PostgreSQL 数据库、S3 兼容的对象存储、环境变量和公共 HTTPS URL。
plugin_asdk_app_6a7c58a845f88191860e59f4.productIntroEn: BasicDeploy lets your assistant create a live container for a web app, deploy code to it, and manage it — all from the chat. Each app comes with a PostgreSQL database, S3-compatible object storage, environment variables, and a public HTTPS URL, set up automatically.
plugin_asdk_app_6a7c58a845f88191860e59f4.longDescription:
BasicDeploy lets your assistant create a live container for a web app, deploy code to it, and manage it — all from the chat. Each app comes with a PostgreSQL database, S3-compatible object storage, environment variables, and a public HTTPS URL, set up automatically.

Through the connector, the assistant can create containers, deploy a project, run shell commands, and read logs. You can also add hosted sign-up and login to the apps you build over standard OpenID Connect, so your app gets its own users without writing an auth system. You sign in once with your BasicDeploy account — no API key to paste. Pricing is a flat monthly rate that includes the database, storage, bandwidth, and URL.
plugin_asdk_app_6a7c58a845f88191860e59f4.longDescriptionZh:
BasicDeploy 可让您的助手为 Web 应用程序创建实时容器、向其部署代码并对其进行管理 — 所有这些都可以通过聊天进行。每个应用程序都附带自动设置的 PostgreSQL 数据库、S3 兼容的对象存储、环境变量和公共 HTTPS URL。

通过连接器，助手可以创建容器、部署项目、运行 shell 命令和读取日志。您还可以将托管注册和登录添加到您通过标准 OpenID Connect 构建的应用程序，以便您的应用程序无需编写身份验证系统即可获得自己的用户。您使用 BasicDeploy 帐户登录一次 — 无需粘贴 API 密钥。定价是每月固定费率，包括数据库、存储、带宽和 URL。

plugin_asdk_app_69c1a1df6f6481918f7c67e9.name: Birdie
plugin_asdk_app_69c1a1df6f6481918f7c67e9.productIntro: Birdie 帮助您捕获客户问题并将其转化为清晰的上下文以进行故障排除。
plugin_asdk_app_69c1a1df6f6481918f7c67e9.productIntroEn: Birdie helps you capture customer issues and turn them into clear context for troubleshooting.
plugin_asdk_app_69c1a1df6f6481918f7c67e9.longDescription:
Birdie helps you capture customer issues and turn them into clear context for troubleshooting.

Instead of relying on written descriptions, customers can record their screen to show the issue. Birdie captures the full context, including what happened, what they clicked, and technical evidence such as console logs, network requests, session data, device metadata, and reproduction steps.

This gives your agent the context it needs to understand the issue, troubleshoot it accurately, and move faster to a resolution.

With Birdie, your agent does not have to guess what the customer meant. It can see what the customer saw and use the right evidence to investigate the issue.

Built for support and technical teams, Birdie reduces back and forth and helps both humans and AI troubleshoot customer issues faster.
plugin_asdk_app_69c1a1df6f6481918f7c67e9.longDescriptionZh:
Birdie 帮助您捕获客户问题并将其转化为清晰的上下文以进行故障排除。

客户可以录制屏幕来显示问题，而不是依赖书面描述。 Birdie 捕获完整的上下文，包括发生的事情、他们点击的内容以及控制台日志、网络请求、会话数据、设备元数据和再现步骤等技术证据。

这为您的代理提供了了解问题、准确排除故障并更快找到解决方案所需的背景信息。

有了 Birdie，您的客服人员就不必猜测客户的意思。它可以看到客户看到的内容并使用正确的证据来调查问题。

Birdie 专为支持和技术团队而设计，可减少往返次数，帮助人类和人工智能更快地解决客户问题。

plugin_asdk_app_6a7aeed8884c8191b86ac870.productIntro: HOME AI 节点让 ChatGPT 检查 HOME AI 节点的运行状况、运行时状态和跟踪任务。 get_node_status 报告节点是否在线及其存储库状态，get_runtime_state 显示运行时模式和 MCP 协议，get_task_status 查询任务进度。
plugin_asdk_app_6a7aeed8884c8191b86ac870.productIntroEn: HOME AI Node lets ChatGPT inspect the health, runtime state, and tracked tasks of a HOME AI node. get_node_status reports whether a node is online and its repository state, get_runtime_state shows the runtime mode and MCP protocol, and get_task_status queries task progress.
plugin_asdk_app_6a7aeed8884c8191b86ac870.longDescription: HOME AI Node lets ChatGPT inspect the health, runtime state, and tracked tasks of a HOME AI node. get_node_status reports whether a node is online and its repository state, get_runtime_state shows the runtime mode and MCP protocol, and get_task_status queries task progress. In this phase the server is backed by a deterministic synthetic review fixture (node review-demo-node) so reviewers can exercise every tool without any private network access; connection to a real HOME AI node is a later phase behind an authorized-user boundary (OAuth). All operations are strictly read-only: nothing on this server can write, execute, or reach any private network.
plugin_asdk_app_6a7aeed8884c8191b86ac870.longDescriptionZh: HOME AI 节点让 ChatGPT 检查 HOME AI 节点的运行状况、运行时状态和跟踪任务。 get_node_status 报告节点是否在线及其存储库状态，get_runtime_state 显示运行时模式和 MCP 协议，get_task_status 查询任务进度。在此阶段，服务器由确定性综合审查装置（节点审查-演示节点）支持，因此审查者可以在没有任何专用网络访问的情况下使用每个工具；与真实 HOME AI 节点的连接是授权用户边界 (OAuth) 后面的后续阶段。所有操作都是严格只读的：该服务器上的任何操作都无法写入、执行或访问任何专用网络。

plugin_asdk_app_6a756da8100c81919d9322e0.name: TALON Knowledge
plugin_asdk_app_6a756da8100c81919d9322e0.description: 搜索 TALON 手册、问答
plugin_asdk_app_6a756da8100c81919d9322e0.productIntro: 一个连接器，可让人工智能代理搜索 TALON 的官方知识库，TALON 是一个用于构建业务应用程序的低代码平台。它搜索数千页官方手册、支持问答、900多个实际功能配置示例的数据库和规范分析，并以源 URL 为证据返回答案。典型用途包括功能设计咨询、配置值查找、错误原因调查、浏览类似的现实示例以及生成的设置的自动验证。
plugin_asdk_app_6a756da8100c81919d9322e0.productIntroEn: A connector that lets AI agents search the official knowledge base of TALON, a low-code platform for building business applications. It searches thousands of pages of official manuals, support Q&A, a database of 900+ real-world function configuration examples, and specification analyses, and returns answers with source URLs as evidence.
plugin_asdk_app_6a756da8100c81919d9322e0.longDescription:
A connector that lets AI agents search the official knowledge base of TALON, a low-code platform for building business applications. It searches thousands of pages of official manuals, support Q&A, a database of 900+ real-world function configuration examples, and specification analyses, and returns answers with source URLs as evidence. Typical uses include feature design consultation, configuration value lookups, error-cause investigation, browsing similar real-world examples, and automated validation of generated settings.

A TALON maintenance contract and a TALON support site (Zendesk) account are required. Users authenticate by signing in to the support site when connecting. All tools are read-only, and users' conversation content, code, and attachments are never sent to our servers (details: https://mcp.talon.jp/privacy).
plugin_asdk_app_6a756da8100c81919d9322e0.longDescriptionZh:
一个连接器，可让人工智能代理搜索 TALON 的官方知识库，TALON 是一个用于构建业务应用程序的低代码平台。它搜索数千页官方手册、支持问答、900多个实际功能配置示例的数据库和规范分析，并以源 URL 为证据返回答案。典型用途包括功能设计咨询、配置值查找、错误原因调查、浏览类似的现实示例以及生成的设置的自动验证。

需要 TALON 维护合同和 TALON 支持站点 (Zendesk) 帐户。用户通过在连接时登录支持站点进行身份验证。所有工具都是只读的，用户的对话内容、代码和附件永远不会发送到我们的服务器（详情：https://mcp.talon.jp/privacy）。

plugin_asdk_app_6a4d168031448191abcd6540.name: HTML/CSS to Image API
plugin_asdk_app_6a4d168031448191abcd6540.description: HTML 到图像和 URL 屏幕截图
plugin_asdk_app_6a4d168031448191abcd6540.productIntro: HTML/CSS to Image MCP 服务器让 AI 助手可以通过自然语言指令创建可立即投入生产的图像、网站屏幕截图和 PDF。
plugin_asdk_app_6a4d168031448191abcd6540.productIntroEn: The HTML/CSS to Image MCP server lets AI assistants create production-ready images, website screenshots, and PDFs through natural-language instructions.
plugin_asdk_app_6a4d168031448191abcd6540.longDescription:
The HTML/CSS to Image MCP server lets AI assistants create production-ready images, website screenshots, and PDFs through natural-language instructions.

Use it to:

- Render HTML and CSS into PNG, JPG, WebP, or PDF
- Capture screenshots of public URLs
- Generate images from reusable templates and variables
- Create batches of multiple image variations
- Create, update, list, and version image templates
- Configure viewport size, device scale, selectors, render delays, and other rendering options
plugin_asdk_app_6a4d168031448191abcd6540.longDescriptionZh:
HTML/CSS to Image MCP 服务器让 AI 助手可以通过自然语言指令创建可立即投入生产的图像、网站屏幕截图和 PDF。

用它来：

- 将 HTML 和 CSS 渲染为 PNG、JPG、WebP 或 PDF
- 捕获公共 URL 的屏幕截图
- 从可重复使用的模板和变量生成图像
- 创建批量的多个图像变体
- 创建、更新、列出和版本图像模板
- 配置视口大小、设备比例、选择器、渲染延迟和其他渲染选项

Create a batch of my website screenshots across desktop, tablet, and mobile sizes, time zones, and light and dark modes.
Create a reusable event image template with fields for the name, date, location, and call to action, then render an example.
defaultPromptsZh: 为产品发布创建精美的 1200×630 社交图像，字体大胆、现代渐变且具有明确的号召性用语。
创建一批跨桌面、平板电脑和移动设备尺寸、时区以及明暗模式的网站屏幕截图。
创建一个可重用的事件图像模板，其中包含名称、日期、位置和号召性用语字段，然后呈现示例。

Create fully working business software and web apps from a prompt. With Craftian you can create CRMs, task managers, inventory systems, expense trackers, time trackers, job portals, on-boarding portals, data forms etc.

Craftian creates production-ready web apps with built-in database, authentication, role-based access control, file storage, and automatic cloud deployment.

No coding experience required. Just describe what you want, and keep refining it.

plugin_asdk_app_6a3345aed5b081918ae752ac.name: Control Plane
plugin_asdk_app_6a3345aed5b081918ae752ac.description: 部署并运行云应用程序
plugin_asdk_app_6a3345aed5b081918ae752ac.productIntro: Control Plane 将 AWS、GCP、Azure、Oracle Cloud 和您自己的硬件作为一个平台运行容器化应用程序。将 GitHub 或 GitLab 存储库构建到容器中，并将其部署到实时 HTTPS URL，为其提供自定义域，附加 Postgres 或 Redis，并让它自动扩展。从日志、指标和事件中诊断故障，并找到导致云账单膨胀的过度配置工作负载。
plugin_asdk_app_6a3345aed5b081918ae752ac.productIntroEn: Control Plane runs containerized apps across AWS, GCP, Azure, Oracle Cloud, and your own hardware as one platform. Build a GitHub or a GitLab repo into a container and deploy it to a live HTTPS URL, give it a custom domain, attach Postgres or Redis, and let it autoscale. Diagnose failures from logs, metrics, and events, and find the over-provisioned workloads inflating your cloud bill.
plugin_asdk_app_6a3345aed5b081918ae752ac.longDescription: Control Plane runs containerized apps across AWS, GCP, Azure, Oracle Cloud, and your own hardware as one platform. plugin_asdk_app_6a8cf9cd5e8c8191b5e44b8a.productIntro: Bitsweave 是用户拥有的 AI 工具上下文层。它存储组织的结构化工作，通过上下文图将其连接，并通过 MCP 将其公开给 Claude。
plugin_asdk_app_6a8cf9cd5e8c8191b5e44b8a.productIntroEn: Bitsweave is a user-owned context layer for AI tools. It stores the structured work of your organization, connects it via a context graph and exposes it to Claude over MCP.
plugin_asdk_app_6a8cf9cd5e8c8191b5e44b8a.longDescription:
Bitsweave is a user-owned context layer for AI tools. It stores the structured work of your organization, connects it via a context graph and exposes it to Claude over MCP.

Sign in with OAuth. ChatGPT can search and hydrate your org context so you do not repeat who you are, what the project is, or what you already decided.

What you can do:
• Look up a specific fact about your company, a past decision, or a current task.
• Ask a synthesis question across decisions, notes, and related records.
• Create or update a Bitsweave record from the conversation when you want the result stored.

Connect GitHub, email, and other tools through Bitsweave brokers when you enable them. Claude calls Bitsweave. Bitsweave uses the permissions you granted. The agent does not hold the upstream credentials.

Sign-in is required. The connector URL is https://bitsweave.com/api/mcp.

Setup: add Bitsweave, complete the OAuth sign-in, then ask ChatGPT to search your context or create a record. Public docs: https://bitsweave.com/docs/use/onboarding/connect-your-agents
plugin_asdk_app_6a8cf9cd5e8c8191b5e44b8a.longDescriptionZh:
Bitsweave 是用户拥有的 AI 工具上下文层。它存储组织的结构化工作，通过上下文图将其连接，并通过 MCP 将其公开给 Claude。

使用 OAuth 登录。 ChatGPT 可以搜索并补充您的组织上下文，这样您就不会重复您是谁、项目是什么或您已经决定的内容。

你可以做什么：
• 查找有关您公司的具体事实、过去的决定或当前的任务。
• 针对决策、注释和相关记录提出综合问题。
• 当您想要存储结果时，从对话中创建或更新Bitsweave 记录。

当您启用 Bitsweave 代理时，可以通过它们连接 GitHub、电子邮件和其他工具。克劳德称其为 Bitsweave。 Bitsweave 使用您授予的权限。代理不持有上游凭据。

需要登录。连接器 URL 为 https://bitsweave.com/api/mcp。

设置：添加 Bitsweave，完成 OAuth 登录，然后要求 ChatGPT 搜索您的上下文或创建记录。公共文档：https://bitsweave.com/docs/use/onboarding/connect-your-agents
