plugin_asdk_app_6a4e20e5277c8191a2df23e4.name: BranchDeploy
plugin_asdk_app_6a4e20e5277c8191a2df23e4.description: 部署 Azure DevOps 工作项
plugin_asdk_app_6a4e20e5277c8191a2df23e4.productIntro: BranchDeploy 将 ChatGPT 连接到现有的 Azure DevOps 部署工作流程。
plugin_asdk_app_6a4e20e5277c8191a2df23e4.productIntroEn: BranchDeploy connects ChatGPT to your existing Azure DevOps deployment workflow.
plugin_asdk_app_6a4e20e5277c8191a2df23e4.longDescription:
BranchDeploy connects ChatGPT to your existing Azure DevOps deployment workflow.

Preview a work item deployment, confirm the resolved ticket, branch, environment and pipeline, then queue the deployment only if BranchDeploy’s server-side rules allow it.

BranchDeploy does not let ChatGPT deploy arbitrary code. It resolves linked Azure Repos branches and pull requests from the work item, checks the configured environment and branch rules, and requires explicit confirmation before a deployment starts.

Use it to:
- Preview what branch and environment a work item will deploy to
- Confirm the deployment before anything runs
- Queue your existing Azure Pipeline
- Check deployment status
- View recent deployment history
- List configured deployment environments

BranchDeploy wraps your existing Azure Pipeline setup. No YAML changes are required, and deployment safety is enforced server-side using your configured project, environment and branch rules.
plugin_asdk_app_6a4e20e5277c8191a2df23e4.longDescriptionZh:
BranchDeploy 将 ChatGPT 连接到现有的 Azure DevOps 部署工作流程。

预览工作项部署，确认已解析的票证、分支、环境和管道，然后仅在 BranchDeploy 的服务器端规则允许的情况下对部署进行排队。

BranchDeploy 不允许 ChatGPT 部署任意代码。它解析链接的 Azure Repos 分支和来自工作项的拉取请求，检查配置的环境和分支规则，并在部署开始之前需要显式确认。

用它来：
- 预览工作项将部署到的分支和环境
- 在运行任何内容之前确认部署
- 对现有的 Azure Pipeline 进行排队
- 检查部署状态
- 查看最近的部署历史记录
- 列出配置的部署环境

BranchDeploy 包装现有的 Azure Pipeline 设置。无需更改 YAML，并且使用您配置的项目、环境和分支规则在服务器端强制实施部署安全。

plugin_asdk_app_6a856978bdf0819191b886f2.name: RideDesk
plugin_asdk_app_6a856978bdf0819191b886f2.productIntro: RideDesk 是一款用于机场接送、司机、 出租车和车辆租赁运营商 — 运行的传输管理软件 每个运营商的预订、报价、司机、发票和付款 他们自己的品牌。
plugin_asdk_app_6a856978bdf0819191b886f2.productIntroEn: RideDesk is booking and dispatch software for airport transfer, chauffeur, taxi and vehicle-rental operators — transfer management software that runs each operator's bookings, quotes, drivers, invoicing and payments under their own brand.
plugin_asdk_app_6a856978bdf0819191b886f2.longDescription:
RideDesk is booking and dispatch software for airport transfer, chauffeur,
  taxi and vehicle-rental operators — transfer management software that runs
  each operator's bookings, quotes, drivers, invoicing and payments under
  their own brand.

  This plugin serves RideDesk's developer documentation as queryable tools,
  so an agent can pull the exact API contract while building an operator's
  booking website: the three-call quote → book → checkout flow, embeddable
  booking widgets, visitor attribution, live chat, the customer portal, and
  each account's own MCP booking server for AI-agent bookings.

  It is read-only and requires no account or authentication. Actual quotes
  and bookings happen on an operator's own domain, never through this
  plugin — and prices are always computed server-side from the operator's
  own rate card, never by an agent.

  Typical uses: ask for the integration brief before building a booking
  site, look up the checkout contract, fetch widget embed snippets for a
  specific domain, or search the docs for captcha, attribution and
  customer-portal details.
plugin_asdk_app_6a856978bdf0819191b886f2.longDescriptionZh:
RideDesk 是一款用于机场接送、司机、
  出租车和车辆租赁运营商 — 运行的传输管理软件
  每个运营商的预订、报价、司机、发票和付款
  他们自己的品牌。

  该插件将 RideDesk 的开发人员文档作为可查询工具提供服务，
  因此代理可以在构建运营商的 API 合约时提取准确的 API 合约
  预订网站：三通报价→预订→结账流程，可嵌入
  预订小部件、访客归因、实时聊天、客户门户以及
  每个帐户都有自己的 MCP 预订服务器，用于 AI 代理预订。

  它是只读的，不需要帐户或身份验证。实际报价
  并且预订发生在运营商自己的域上，而不是通过此
  插件 - 价格始终在服务器端根据运营商的计算得出
  自己的价目表，绝不是由代理商提供的。

  典型用途：在进行预订之前询问集成简介
  网站，查找结账合同，获取小部件嵌入片段
  特定域，或在文档中搜索验证码、归属地和
  客户门户详细信息。

plugin_asdk_app_6a84283581f08191b0cab726.name: MCP Conduct Register
plugin_asdk_app_6a84283581f08191b0cab726.description: 检查 MCP 服务器行为
plugin_asdk_app_6a84283581f08191b0cab726.productIntro: 该插件公开了 MCP 服务器测量行为的公共记录。
plugin_asdk_app_6a84283581f08191b0cab726.productIntroEn: This plugin exposes a public register of measured conduct for MCP servers.
plugin_asdk_app_6a84283581f08191b0cab726.longDescription:
This plugin exposes a public register of measured conduct for MCP servers.

Five conditions are measured on a schedule: the server speaks MCP, it publishes an A2A agent card, it declares who pays it, identical input returns identical output, and the verdict itself can be recomputed by a third party. A condition that could not be measured is recorded as not measured. It is never counted as a pass, and that rule is not relaxed for the operator of the register.

The register does not rank servers. It does not recommend one server over another. It returns what was measured, when it was measured, and the SHA-256 of the record so that the reading can be checked by someone who does not trust the party that issued it.

An endpoint that is absent from the register has simply never been measured here. Absence is reported as absence and is not a negative verdict.

Determinism is not measured unless the owner of the checked server has recorded consent, because measuring it requires executing a tool on someone else's server.

Free, read only, no account and no key. The register is a build artefact of a scheduled script with no editorial step, and it is archived with a DOI so a citation survives the repository moving.
plugin_asdk_app_6a84283581f08191b0cab726.longDescriptionZh:
该插件公开了 MCP 服务器测量行为的公共记录。

按计划测量五个条件：服务器讲 MCP、发布 A2A 代理卡、声明谁付款、相同的输入返回相同的输出以及判决本身可以由第三方重新计算。无法测量的条件将记录为未测量。它永远不会被算作通行证，而且对于收银机操作员来说，这一规则也没有放松。

该寄存器不对服务器进行排名。它不推荐一台服务器而不是另一台服务器。它返回测量的内容、测量时间以及记录的 SHA-256，以便不信任发布方的人可以检查读数。

寄存器中不存在的端点根本就没有在这里被测量过。缺席报告为缺席，并非负面判决。

除非被检查服务器的所有者已记录同意，否则不会测量确定性，因为测量它需要在其他人的服务器上执行工具。

免费，只读，无帐户，无密钥。该寄存器是预定脚本的构建产物，没有编辑步骤，并且使用 DOI 进行存档，因此引用在存储库移动后仍然存在。

Measure https://mcp.horizonshield.dev/mcp against the register's conditions and tell me which conditions could not be measured.

defaultPromptsZh: 该寄存器测量什么，以及它明确未验证什么？
根据寄存器的条件测量 https://mcp.horizonshield.dev/mcp 并告诉我哪些条件无法测量。
https://gate.horizonshield.dev/mcp 是否在寄存器上？上次测量是什么时候？

plugin_asdk_app_6a59c91637e8819194bdb1d1.description: 将您的人工智能连接到一个大脑。
plugin_asdk_app_6a59c91637e8819194bdb1d1.originalDescription: Connect your AI to one brain.
plugin_asdk_app_6a59c91637e8819194bdb1d1.productIntro: Stem是一种持久的跨AI记忆。连接一次，ChatGPT 就可以存储精炼的记忆（决策、事实、偏好、项目背景），在未来的聊天中回忆起最相关的记忆，将相关的想法链接到类型化的知识图中，并在 awase.dev/stem 上查看所有可视化内容。用户连接的每个 MCP 兼容工具都可以使用相同的内存，因此无需重新解释上下文。包含免费套餐；存储层是可选的。
plugin_asdk_app_6a59c91637e8819194bdb1d1.productIntroEn: Stem is a persistent cross-AI memory. Connect it once and ChatGPT can store distilled memories (decisions, facts, preferences, project context), recall the most relevant ones in any future chat, link related ideas into a typed knowledge graph, and see it all visualized at awase.dev/stem.
plugin_asdk_app_6a59c91637e8819194bdb1d1.longDescription: Stem is a persistent cross-AI memory. Connect it once and ChatGPT can store distilled memories (decisions, facts, preferences, project context), recall the most relevant ones in any future chat, link related ideas into a typed knowledge graph, and see it all visualized at awase.dev/stem. The same memory is available to every MCP-compatible tool the user connects, so context never has to be re-explained. Free tier included; storage tiers are opt-in.

plugin_asdk_app_6a95fefc5c1081919756fdd3.name: Kody
plugin_asdk_app_6a95fefc5c1081919756fdd3.description: 将代理工作转变为软件
plugin_asdk_app_6a95fefc5c1081919756fdd3.productIntro: Kody 将 ChatGPT 中的成功成果转化为耐用的、用户拥有的软件。 ChatGPT 可以使用 Kody 查找用户的可用功能，并将工作解决方案转变为可重用的包、时间表、网络钩子、便携式内存和秘密支持的连接。凭证保留在服务器端，安装的社区包被分叉到用户的帐户中，并且保存的工作流可以稍后运行，而无需再次调用模型。相同的用户拥有的工件在支持 MCP 的代理中仍然可用。
plugin_asdk_app_6a95fefc5c1081919756fdd3.productIntroEn: Kody turns successful work in ChatGPT into durable, user-owned software. ChatGPT can use Kody to find the user's available capabilities and turn working solutions into reusable packages, schedules, webhooks, portable memories, and secret-backed connections.
plugin_asdk_app_6a95fefc5c1081919756fdd3.longDescription: Kody turns successful work in ChatGPT into durable, user-owned software. ChatGPT can use Kody to find the user's available capabilities and turn working solutions into reusable packages, schedules, webhooks, portable memories, and secret-backed connections. Credentials remain server-side, installed community packages are forked into the user's account, and saved workflows can run later without another model call. The same user-owned artifacts remain available across MCP-capable agents.
plugin_asdk_app_6a95fefc5c1081919756fdd3.longDescriptionZh: Kody 将 ChatGPT 中的成功成果转化为耐用的、用户拥有的软件。 ChatGPT 可以使用 Kody 查找用户的可用功能，并将工作解决方案转变为可重用的包、时间表、网络钩子、便携式内存和秘密支持的连接。凭证保留在服务器端，安装的社区包被分叉到用户的帐户中，并且保存的工作流可以稍后运行，而无需再次调用模型。相同的用户拥有的工件在支持 MCP 的代理中仍然可用。

plugin_asdk_app_69e8f280ed74819195654f4c.description: 无需离开聊天即可运行 SQL
plugin_asdk_app_69e8f280ed74819195654f4c.productIntro: DB Fiddle 插件允许用户直接从 ChatGPT 和 Codex 在一次性沙箱环境中运行 SQL。
plugin_asdk_app_69e8f280ed74819195654f4c.productIntroEn: The DB Fiddle plugin lets users run SQL against a disposable sandbox environment, directly from ChatGPT and Codex.
plugin_asdk_app_69e8f280ed74819195654f4c.longDescription:
The DB Fiddle plugin lets users run SQL against a disposable sandbox environment, directly from ChatGPT and Codex.

Create database schemas, load sample data, execute queries, and inspect real database results without connecting to a production database or external system.

The sandbox provides the perfect place for ChatGPT and Codex to iterate on queries and safely debug SQL, reproduce database issues, validate queries and experiment with any of the supported database engines.

Supported database engines: PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, SQLite and more.

Note: A db-fiddle.com PRO subscription is required to use this plugin.
plugin_asdk_app_69e8f280ed74819195654f4c.longDescriptionZh:
DB Fiddle 插件允许用户直接从 ChatGPT 和 Codex 在一次性沙箱环境中运行 SQL。

创建数据库模式、加载示例数据、执行查询并检查真实数据库结果，而无需连接到生产数据库或外部系统。

沙箱为 ChatGPT 和 Codex 提供了完美的场所，可以迭代查询并安全地调试 SQL、重现数据库问题、验证查询以及使用任何受支持的数据库引擎进行实验。

支持的数据库引擎：PostgreSQL、MySQL、MariaDB、SQLite 等。

注意：使用此插件需要 db-fiddle.com PRO 订阅。
defaultPrompts: Run an example query using Postgres build JSON object
defaultPromptsZh: 使用 Postgres 构建 JSON 对象运行示例查询

plugin_asdk_app_6a95d3a05d888191945f40e3.name: Unblocked
plugin_asdk_app_6a95d3a05d888191945f40e3.productIntro: Unblocked 是代理软件开发的上下文层。它对您的代码、对话、问题、文档、产品和生产系统进行推理，以便代理可以在更少的人工干预下正确完成工作。
plugin_asdk_app_6a95d3a05d888191945f40e3.productIntroEn: Unblocked is the context layer for agentic software development. It reasons across your code, conversations, issues, docs, product, and production systems so agents can complete work correctly with less human intervention.
plugin_asdk_app_6a95d3a05d888191945f40e3.longDescription:
Unblocked is the context layer for agentic software development. It reasons across your code, conversations, issues, docs, product, and production systems so agents can complete work correctly with less human intervention.

Coding agents know the code. They do not know why it was written that way, which of two conflicting docs is current, what a ticket decided, or what production is doing right now. Unblocked gives them that organizational understanding by connecting the context scattered across your code, messaging platforms, issue trackers, documentation, and product and production data, reconciling conflicts between sources, and enforcing the permissions you already set in each tool.

One MCP server replaces a dozen. Context is ranked, compressed, and assembled server-side before it reaches the agent, so the agent reasons over higher-quality input. The result: reliable code that reflects how your team actually builds software, generated with fewer tokens and less back-and-forth.

Works with Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, GitHub Copilot, and Codex over MCP, or through the Unblocked CLI and API. Connects to GitHub, GitLab, Slack, Microsoft Teams, Jira, Linear, Confluence, Notion, Google Drive, Sentry, Datadog, and more.
plugin_asdk_app_6a95d3a05d888191945f40e3.longDescriptionZh:
Unblocked 是代理软件开发的上下文层。它对您的代码、对话、问题、文档、产品和生产系统进行推理，以便代理可以在更少的人工干预下正确完成工作。

编码代理知道代码。他们不知道为什么要这样写，两个相互冲突的文档中哪一个是最新的，票决定了什么，或者生产现在正在做什么。 Unblocked 通过连接分散在代码、消息传递平台、问题跟踪器、文档以及产品和生产数据中的上下文，协调来源之间的冲突，并强制执行您在每个工具中设置的权限，为他们提供组织理解。

一台 MCP 服务器取代了十几台。上下文在到达代理之前会在服务器端进行排名、压缩和组装，因此代理会推理出更高质量的输入。结果是：可靠的代码反映了您的团队实际如何构建软件，并且使用更少的令牌和更少的来回生成。

通过 MCP 或通过 Unblocked CLI 和 API 与 Claude Code、Cursor、Windsurf、GitHub Copilot 和 Codex 配合使用。连接到 GitHub、GitLab、Slack、Microsoft Teams、Jira、Linear、Confluence、Notion、Google Drive、Sentry、Datadog 等。

plugin_asdk_app_6a94a662697881919b8eb7c8.productIntro: 直接从 ChatGPT 和 Codex 管理您的 BoxToPlay 游戏服务器、VPS 和网络托管。
plugin_asdk_app_6a94a662697881919b8eb7c8.productIntroEn: Manage your BoxToPlay game servers, VPS, and web hosting directly from ChatGPT and Codex.
plugin_asdk_app_6a94a662697881919b8eb7c8.longDescription:
Manage your BoxToPlay game servers, VPS, and web hosting directly from ChatGPT and Codex.

Manage Minecraft hosting, BungeeCord and Velocity proxies, TeamSpeak voice servers, VPS, and hosted websites from one place.

Depending on the service, you can:
• Monitor live service status, players, performance, health, and logs
• Investigate crashes, startup failures, and plugin, mod, or proxy issues using logs and health checks
• Manage files, settings, backups, firewall rules, and DNS records
• Start, stop, and restart services, and track long-running operations

Access is restricted to services in your authenticated BoxToPlay account and the permissions granted to the app.
plugin_asdk_app_6a94a662697881919b8eb7c8.longDescriptionZh:
直接从 ChatGPT 和 Codex 管理您的 BoxToPlay 游戏服务器、VPS 和网络托管。

从一处管理 Minecraft 托管、BungeeCord 和 Velocity 代理、TeamSpeak 语音服务器、VPS 和托管网站。

根据服务的不同，您可以：

plugin_asdk_app_6aa95107d094819192324cfe.name: Limrun
plugin_asdk_app_6aa95107d094819192324cfe.description: 在云模拟器上测试应用程序
plugin_asdk_app_6aa95107d094819192324cfe.productIntro: Limrun 在云端为您的代理提供 iOS 模拟器和 Android 模拟器。只需要一个设备，它就会在几秒钟内准备就绪，如果您需要的话，还可以预装您的应用程序。从那里，代理以测试人员的方式工作：获取屏幕截图、读取可访问性树、点击、键入、滚动、打开 URL、启动应用程序并提取日志。完成后删除设备，或让它自行关闭。
plugin_asdk_app_6aa95107d094819192324cfe.productIntroEn: Limrun gives your agent iOS simulators and Android emulators in the cloud. Ask for a device and it is ready in seconds, with your app pre-installed if you want. From there the agent works the way a tester would: it takes screenshots, reads the accessibility tree, taps, types, scrolls, opens URLs, launches apps and pulls logs.
plugin_asdk_app_6aa95107d094819192324cfe.longDescription:
Limrun gives your agent iOS simulators and Android emulators in the cloud. Ask for a device and it is ready in seconds, with your app pre-installed if you want. From there the agent works the way a tester would: it takes screenshots, reads the accessibility tree, taps, types, scrolls, opens URLs, launches apps and pulls logs. Delete the device when you are done, or let it shut down on its own.

Building apps and anything that touches local files stays with the lim CLI. The server tells the agent where that line is and hands it the step-by-step CLI instructions when needed.
plugin_asdk_app_6aa95107d094819192324cfe.longDescriptionZh:
Limrun 在云端为您的代理提供 iOS 模拟器和 Android 模拟器。只需要一个设备，它就会在几秒钟内准备就绪，如果您需要的话，还可以预装您的应用程序。从那里，代理以测试人员的方式工作：获取屏幕截图、读取可访问性树、点击、键入、滚动、打开 URL、启动应用程序并提取日志。完成后删除设备，或让它自行关闭。

构建应用程序和任何涉及本地文件的内容都保留在 lim CLI 中。服务器告诉代理该线路的位置，并在需要时向其提供分步 CLI 指令。

plugin_asdk_app_6a3676302a7c8191b136b250.name: LabWired
plugin_asdk_app_6a3676302a7c8191b136b250.description: 在虚拟芯片上运行固件
plugin_asdk_app_6a3676302a7c8191b136b250.productIntro: LabWired 在微控制器（ARM Cortex-M、RISC-V 和 ESP32）的确定性模拟上运行真正的嵌入式固件，就在对话中。选择一块板，将 MCU 与传感器、显示器和总线连接起来，编译固件，然后在您可以观看的交互式硬件实验室中运行它 - 无需物理板。刷新到真实芯片的相同固件二进制文件在模拟器中运行，因此结果具有足够的可重复性，可以进行调试和打开 CI。
plugin_asdk_app_6a3676302a7c8191b136b250.productIntroEn: LabWired runs real embedded firmware on a deterministic simulation of microcontrollers (ARM Cortex-M, RISC-V, and ESP32), right inside the conversation. Pick a board, wire up an MCU with sensors, displays, and buses, compile firmware, and run it in an interactive hardware lab you can watch — no physical board required.
plugin_asdk_app_6a3676302a7c8191b136b250.longDescription: LabWired runs real embedded firmware on a deterministic simulation of microcontrollers (ARM Cortex-M, RISC-V, and ESP32), right inside the conversation. Pick a board, wire up an MCU with sensors, displays, and buses, compile firmware, and run it in an interactive hardware lab you can watch — no physical board required. The same firmware binary that flashes to real silicon runs in the simulator, so results are reproducible enough to debug and to gate CI on. LabWired validates your wiring before it runs, lists the boards and components it supports, compiles firmware from source, and opens a live lab view embedded in ChatGPT where you can see GPIO, serial output, and peripherals respond in real time.
plugin_asdk_app_6a3676302a7c8191b136b250.longDescriptionZh: LabWired 在微控制器（ARM Cortex-M、RISC-V 和 ESP32）的确定性模拟上运行真正的嵌入式固件，就在对话中。选择一块板，将 MCU 与传感器、显示器和总线连接起来，编译固件，然后在您可以观看的交互式硬件实验室中运行它 - 无需物理板。刷新到真实芯片的相同固件二进制文件在模拟器中运行，因此结果具有足够的可重复性，可以进行调试和打开 CI。 LabWired 在运行之前验证您的接线，列出它支持的板和组件，从源代码编译固件，并打开嵌入在 ChatGPT 中的实时实验室视图，您可以在其中实时查看 GPIO、串行输出和外设响应。

plugin_asdk_app_6a91e4895594819184be7d56.name: Tessryx
plugin_asdk_app_6a91e4895594819184be7d56.description: 构建和托管实时网络应用程序
plugin_asdk_app_6a91e4895594819184be7d56.originalDescription: Build and host live web apps
plugin_asdk_app_6a91e4895594819184be7d56.productIntro: Tessryx 为代理提供了构建的地方。它通过聊天为真实网站、API 或内部工具创建数据、逻辑、页面和计划作业，并且 Tessryx 将它们托管在用户自己域的公共 URL 上。不会生成供用户部署的代码，也无需在本地运行任何内容。
plugin_asdk_app_6a91e4895594819184be7d56.productIntroEn: Tessryx gives an agent somewhere to build. From chat, it creates the data, logic, pages and scheduled jobs for a real website, API or internal tool, and Tessryx hosts them at a public URL on the user's own domain. No code is generated for the user to deploy and nothing needs to be run locally.
plugin_asdk_app_6a91e4895594819184be7d56.longDescription:
Tessryx gives an agent somewhere to build. From chat, it creates the data, logic, pages and scheduled jobs for a real website, API or internal tool, and Tessryx hosts them at a public URL on the user's own domain. No code is generated for the user to deploy and nothing needs to be run locally.

The main workflows the tools support:
- Author a JSON Schema, then datafiles validated against it. The same schema generates an editing interface, so a non-technical person can maintain the content afterwards without an agent.
- Author workflows that return HTML or JSON, and bind them to public URLs as dynamic endpoints with edge caching. One endpoint serves both a rendered page and the API routes that page's own JavaScript calls.
- Define parameterized HTTP calls to external systems, with credentials held as write-only secrets the assistant can reference but never read.
- Schedule workflows on a cron or interval so data recomputes on its own.
- Claim and verify a custom domain and serve any of the above from it.

Authentication is OAuth 2.1; there are no API keys for the user to manage.
plugin_asdk_app_6a91e4895594819184be7d56.longDescriptionZh:
Tessryx 为代理提供了构建的地方。它通过聊天为真实网站、API 或内部工具创建数据、逻辑、页面和计划作业，并且 Tessryx 将它们托管在用户自己域的公共 URL 上。不会生成供用户部署的代码，也无需在本地运行任何内容。

该工具支持的主要工作流程：
- 编写 JSON 架构，然后根据它验证数据文件。相同的模式生成编辑界面，因此非技术人员可以在没有代理的情况下维护内容。
- 编写返回 HTML 或 JSON 的工作流程，并将它们作为具有边缘缓存的动态端点绑定到公共 URL。一个端点同时服务于呈现的页面和 API 路由该页面自己的 JavaScript 调用。
- 定义对外部系统的参数化 HTTP 调用，并将凭证保存为只写机密，助手可以引用但永远不会读取。
- 按 cron 或间隔安排工作流程，以便数据自行重新计算。
- 声明并验证自定义域并从中提供上述任何服务。

身份验证为 OAuth 2.1；没有供用户管理的 API 密钥。

plugin_asdk_app_6a1e153fb60c8191a1532e5d.name: Better Design
plugin_asdk_app_6a1e153fb60c8191a1532e5d.description: 人工智能代理的设计系统
plugin_asdk_app_6a1e153fb60c8191a1532e5d.productIntro: Better Design 为 AI 编码代理提供了用于前端工作的设计工程层。
plugin_asdk_app_6a1e153fb60c8191a1532e5d.productIntroEn: Better Design gives AI coding agents a design-engineering layer for frontend work.
plugin_asdk_app_6a1e153fb60c8191a1532e5d.longDescription:
Better Design gives AI coding agents a design-engineering layer for frontend work.

Design Intelligence mode loads UI principles before the agent writes UI code, then asks the agent to self-review against accessibility, visual design, motion, content, and comprehension rules. It helps catch issues like weak hierarchy, inaccessible controls, distracting motion, unclear copy, and missing reduced-motion behavior before code is presented.

Scaffold mode lets an agent install a complete shadcn-compatible visual system: tokens, globals, and component source. Better Design can also generate a new custom design system from a natural-language prompt and return a shadcn install command for the resulting registry.

The MCP server exposes tools for finding and generating design systems, loading UI/UX and React Native guidance, reviewing interface quality, extracting existing CSS tokens, and installing icon components. Tools are served from a public HTTPS endpoint and authenticated with OAuth for hosted ChatGPT and Codex use.
plugin_asdk_app_6a1e153fb60c8191a1532e5d.longDescriptionZh:
Better Design 为 AI 编码代理提供了用于前端工作的设计工程层。

设计智能模式在代理编写 UI 代码之前加载 UI 原则，然后要求代理根据可访问性、视觉设计、动作、内容和理解规则进行自我审查。它有助于在代码呈现之前发现诸如层次结构薄弱、无法访问的控件、分散注意力的运动、不清楚的副本以及缺少简化运动行为等问题。

脚手架模式允许代理安装完整的 shadcn 兼容视觉系统：令牌、全局变量和组件源。 Better Design 还可以根据自然语言提示生成新的自定义设计系统，并为生成的注册表返回 shadcn 安装命令。

MCP 服务器公开了用于查找和生成设计系统、加载 UI/UX 和 React Native 指南、检查界面质量、提取现有 CSS 令牌以及安装图标组件的工具。工具由公共 HTTPS 端点提供，并通过 OAuth 进行身份验证，以供托管 ChatGPT 和 Codex 使用。

plugin_asdk_app_6aa2c81fc7c48191a06e1018.name: Termalin
plugin_asdk_app_6aa2c81fc7c48191a06e1018.description: 通过聊天管理您的服务器
plugin_asdk_app_6aa2c81fc7c48191a06e1018.productIntro: Termalin 将您的服务器连接到聊天。要求 ChatGPT 检查磁盘空间、跟踪日志、重新启动服务、编辑配置或安装软件包 - 它通过 SSH 运行实际命令，并通过 SFTP 在您注册的服务器上读取或写入文件，并在对话中报告。它还可以列出表并通过相同的安全路径对数据库运行只读或完整查询。任何 SSH 密钥都不会粘贴到任何地方：服务器通过 Termalin 连接器向外连接（单行安装），每次运行都使用短期证书进行身份验证，并且通过您的 termal.
plugin_asdk_app_6aa2c81fc7c48191a06e1018.productIntroEn: Termalin connects your servers to the chat. Ask ChatGPT to check disk space, tail a log, restart a service, edit a config or install a package — it runs real commands over SSH and reads or writes files over SFTP on the servers you enrolled, and reports back in the conversation. It can also list tables and run read-only or full queries on your databases through the same secure path.
plugin_asdk_app_6aa2c81fc7c48191a06e1018.longDescription:
Termalin connects your servers to the chat. Ask ChatGPT to check disk space, tail a log, restart a service, edit a config or install a package — it runs real commands over SSH and reads or writes files over SFTP on the servers you enrolled, and reports back in the conversation. It can also list tables and run read-only or full queries on your databases through the same secure path. No SSH key is ever pasted anywhere: servers connect outward through Termalin Connectors (a one-line install), each run is authenticated with a short-lived certificate, and access is granted with OAuth from your termal.in account. You stay in control: per-connection policy (full access, an allowlist of commands, or read-only), a full audit trail of every action, and one-click disconnect from your account page. Works alongside the Termalin desktop app (Windows/macOS/Linux) and web cabinet, but needs neither to be open.

To get started you need a termal.in account (Pro, Team or trial) with at least one Connector enrolled (Settings → Connectors, a one-line install) and a verified email.
plugin_asdk_app_6aa2c81fc7c48191a06e1018.longDescriptionZh:
Termalin 将您的服务器连接到聊天。要求 ChatGPT 检查磁盘空间、跟踪日志、重新启动服务、编辑配置或安装软件包 - 它通过 SSH 运行实际命令，并通过 SFTP 在您注册的服务器上读取或写入文件，并在对话中报告。它还可以列出表并通过相同的安全路径对数据库运行只读或完整查询。任何 SSH 密钥都不会粘贴到任何地方：服务器通过 Termalin 连接器向外连接（单行安装），每次运行都使用短期证书进行身份验证，并且通过您的 termal.in 帐户通过 OAuth 授予访问权限。您始终掌控一切：每个连接的策略（完全访问权限、命令允许列表或只读）、每个操作的完整审核跟踪以及一键从帐户页面断开连接。与 Termalin 桌面应用程序 (Windows/macOS/Linux) 和网络柜一起使用，但两者都不需要打开。

首先，您需要一个 termal.in 帐户（专业版、团队版或试用版），并至少注册一个连接器（设置 → 连接器，单行安装）和经过验证的电子邮件。

plugin_asdk_app_6aa10c1a74c48191bd03e523.name: MacroDroid Macro Builder
plugin_asdk_app_6aa10c1a74c48191bd03e523.originalDescription: Build a macro by describing it
plugin_asdk_app_6aa10c1a74c48191bd03e523.productIntro: 用日常语言描述您想要的自动化，并获取完整的 MacroDroid 宏，准备导入到您的 Android 手机上。
plugin_asdk_app_6aa10c1a74c48191bd03e523.productIntroEn: Describe the automation you want in everyday language and get a complete MacroDroid macro back, ready to import on your Android phone.
plugin_asdk_app_6aa10c1a74c48191bd03e523.longDescription:
Describe the automation you want in everyday language and get a complete MacroDroid macro back, ready to import on your Android phone.

MacroDroid is the Android automation app used daily by over a million users to automate their device with triggers, actions and constraints: silence the phone in meetings, turn off WiFi when the battery is low, read messages aloud while driving, send your location when you get home, and thousands more.

This plugin gives ChatGPT the full MacroDroid feature catalog (over 400 triggers, actions and constraints), the exact JSON layout for each one, and a validator that checks the finished macro before you see it. Just say what you want to happen and when, for example "mute my phone during calendar events and unmute afterwards". ChatGPT picks the right features, writes the macro and validates it.

Import the result by saving it as a .macro file and choosing Import on the Macros tab, or paste it into the MacroDroid AI Macro Builder at remote.macrodroid.com to send it straight to your phone.

No account or sign-in is needed. Nothing you type is stored by MacroDroid.
plugin_asdk_app_6aa10c1a74c48191bd03e523.longDescriptionZh:
用日常语言描述您想要的自动化，并获取完整的 MacroDroid 宏，准备导入到您的 Android 手机上。

MacroDroid 是一款 Android 自动化应用程序，每天有超过 100 万用户使用，通过触发器、操作和约束来自动化他们的设备：在会议中使手机静音、在电池电量低时关闭 WiFi、在驾驶时大声朗读消息、在您到家时发送您的位置等等。

该插件为 ChatGPT 提供了完整的 MacroDroid 功能目录（超过 400 个触发器、操作和约束）、每个功能的精确 JSON 布局，以及在您看到宏之前检查完成的宏的验证器。只需说出您想要发生的事情和时间，例如“在日历活动期间将我的手机静音，然后取消静音”。 ChatGPT 选择正确的功能，编写宏并验证它。

通过将结果另存为 .macro 文件并在“宏”选项卡上选择“导入”来导入结果，或将其粘贴到位于 remote.macrodroid.com 的 MacroDroid AI 宏生成器中，将其直接发送到您的手机。

无需帐户或登录。 MacroDroid 不会存储您键入的任何内容。

plugin_asdk_app_6aa3f3a9942c8191994362f6.description: 获取应用程序的范围和成本
plugin_asdk_app_6aa3f3a9942c8191994362f6.originalDescription: Get scope and costs for apps
plugin_asdk_app_6aa3f3a9942c8191994362f6.productIntro: 将应用创意转化为详细的需求、MVP 范围和估计的一次性开发成本。
plugin_asdk_app_6aa3f3a9942c8191994362f6.productIntroEn: Turn app ideas into detailed requirements, an MVP scope and an estimated one-time development cost.
plugin_asdk_app_6aa3f3a9942c8191994362f6.longDescription:
Turn app ideas into detailed requirements, an MVP scope and an estimated one-time development cost.

Plan a mobile app, web app or AI solution before development begins. ChatStack helps clarify your idea and produces structured product requirements, user stories, technical specifications and a development cost breakdown.

Refine your scope and use the resulting specification with your chosen developers or AI coding tools. Estimates include assumptions and exclusions and are subject to project review.

Created by App Developer Studio. A consultation with the team is optional.
plugin_asdk_app_6aa3f3a9942c8191994362f6.longDescriptionZh:
将应用创意转化为详细的需求、MVP 范围和估计的一次性开发成本。

在开发开始之前规划移动应用程序、网络应用程序或人工智能解决方案。 ChatStack 帮助阐明您的想法并生成结构化的产品需求、用户故事、技术规范和开发成本明细。

细化您的范围，并与您选择的开发人员或 AI 编码工具一起使用生成的规范。估算包括假设和排除情况，并需接受项目审查。

由应用程序开发工作室创建。与团队的协商是可选的。

I have an idea for an app and need to find the best way to build it and what it will cost

plugin_asdk_app_6a91978e41a08191a6e7519c.productIntro: Chartquery 从 ChatGPT 生成图表、图表、QR 码、条形码和标签。描述数据或有效负载并获取可以打开的公共渲染 URL。
plugin_asdk_app_6a91978e41a08191a6e7519c.productIntroEn: Chartquery generates charts, diagrams, QR codes, barcodes, and labels from ChatGPT. Describe the data or payload and get a public render URL you can open.
plugin_asdk_app_6a91978e41a08191a6e7519c.longDescription:
Chartquery generates charts, diagrams, QR codes, barcodes, and labels from ChatGPT. Describe the data or payload and get a public render URL you can open.

Charts: AI chart from a brief, or a structured chart payload. Diagrams: AI flowchart or a structured diagram. Codes: QR for URLs and Code128 barcodes. Labels: preview, parse, validate, convert, compile. Visual tools return https://api.chartquery.com/v1/{kind}/render/{id}?utm_source=chatgpt.com. Show that URL.

Sign in with your Chartquery account when you connect. Calls use the same credits and quotas as app.chartquery.com.
plugin_asdk_app_6a91978e41a08191a6e7519c.longDescriptionZh:
Chartquery 从 ChatGPT 生成图表、图表、QR 码、条形码和标签。描述数据或有效负载并获取可以打开的公共渲染 URL。

图表：来自摘要或结构化图表有效负载的 AI 图表。图表：AI 流程图或结构化图表。代码：URL 的 QR 和 Code128 条形码。标签：预览、解析、验证、转换、编译。可视化工具返回 https://api.chartquery.com/v1/{kind}/render/{id}?utm_source=chatgpt.com。显示该网址。

连接时使用您的 Chartquery 帐户登录。调用使用与 app.chartquery.com 相同的积分和配额。

plugin_asdk_app_6a4e3e11f6688191a42f71a4.name: Componecat
plugin_asdk_app_6a4e3e11f6688191a42f71a4.productIntro: Componecat 是您组织的软件目录：您运行的每个系统、服务、库和 API，其所有者、依赖项、文档和端点都位于一处。该插件使 ChatGPT 可以直接访问该目录。
plugin_asdk_app_6a4e3e11f6688191a42f71a4.productIntroEn: Componecat is your organization's software catalog: every system, service, library, and API you run, with owners, dependencies, documentation, and endpoints in one place. This plugin gives ChatGPT direct access to that catalog.
plugin_asdk_app_6a4e3e11f6688191a42f71a4.longDescription:
Componecat is your organization's software catalog: every system, service, library, and API you run, with owners, dependencies, documentation, and endpoints in one place. This plugin gives ChatGPT direct access to that catalog.

Ask questions in plain language and get answers from your real software landscape: which team owns the billing service, what depends on the auth API, where the runbook for the payments gateway lives, or which endpoints a component exposes. Search takes precise filters, so one question can cover a whole slice of the catalog. Documentation for each component is available in full, including sections synced from Git, so you can read it and reason about it without leaving the conversation.

You can also keep the catalog current from chat: add or update components, record relationships, attach documentation links, and review recent activity.

Componecat's own product documentation is included too, so ChatGPT can explain how the platform works and walk you through it.

A Componecat account is required. Catalogs are private to your organization, and you sign in with your existing account when connecting.
plugin_asdk_app_6a4e3e11f6688191a42f71a4.longDescriptionZh:
Componecat 是您组织的软件目录：您运行的每个系统、服务、库和 API，其所有者、依赖项、文档和端点都位于一处。该插件使 ChatGPT 可以直接访问该目录。

用简单的语言提出问题，并从真实的软件环境中获得答案：哪个团队拥有计费服务、什么依赖于身份验证 API、支付网关的运行手册位于何处，或者组件公开哪些端点。搜索需要精确的过滤器，因此一个问题可以覆盖整个目录。每个组件的文档都是完整的，包括从 Git 同步的部分，因此您可以在不离开对话的情况下阅读它并对其进行推理。

您还可以通过聊天保持目录最新：添加或更新组件、记录关系、附加文档链接以及查看最近的活动。

Componecat 自己的产品文档也包含在内，因此 ChatGPT 可以解释该平台的工作原理并引导您完成它。

需要 Componecat 帐户。目录对您的组织是私有的，您在连接时使用现有帐户登录。

plugin_asdk_app_6a7ae2ab834c8191a93649ac.productIntro: doDomain 是域连接即服务：它为产品提供引导流程，将客户自己的域指向该产品，并处理其背后的 DNS 记录、验证和证书。 doDomain 插件可让 ChatGPT 从您的帐户驱动该工作：检查域的当前 DNS 状态、列出您的团队中配置的应用程序、列出现有的域连接、为客户创建新的连接会话、查找已启动的会话、在记录到位后验证会话，以及对已漂移的连接重新运行验证。
plugin_asdk_app_6a7ae2ab834c8191a93649ac.productIntroEn: doDomain is domain-connect-as-a-service: it gives a product a guided flow for pointing a customer's own domain at that product, and handles the DNS records, verification, and certificates behind it.
plugin_asdk_app_6a7ae2ab834c8191a93649ac.longDescription:
doDomain is domain-connect-as-a-service: it gives a product a guided flow for pointing a customer's own domain at that product, and handles the DNS records, verification, and certificates behind it. The doDomain plugin lets ChatGPT drive that work from your account: check a domain's current DNS state, list the apps configured on your team, list existing domain connections, create a new connect session for a customer, look up a session you already started, verify a session once the records are in place, and re-run verification on a connection that has drifted.

Access runs through OAuth 2.1 with PKCE and dynamic client registration. Scopes are granted per capability on the consent screen — separate read and write scopes for domains, apps, connections, and sessions — and a tool whose scope you did not grant is never offered to the assistant. Connected apps can be revoked at any time from the Connected Apps page in the dashboard. Tool responses are written against a narrow contract: secret API keys are never returned, and doDomain's billing surface is not reachable over the plugin at all.

Creating a connect session counts against your plan's monthly connection quota; verification checks are rate limited, so a repeated re-verify on the same connection will be told to wait rather than silently retried.
plugin_asdk_app_6a7ae2ab834c8191a93649ac.longDescriptionZh:
doDomain 是域连接即服务：它为产品提供引导流程，将客户自己的域指向该产品，并处理其背后的 DNS 记录、验证和证书。 doDomain 插件可让 ChatGPT 从您的帐户驱动该工作：检查域的当前 DNS 状态、列出您的团队中配置的应用程序、列出现有的域连接、为客户创建新的连接会话、查找已启动的会话、在记录到位后验证会话，以及对已漂移的连接重新运行验证。

访问通过带有 PKCE 和动态客户端注册的 OAuth 2.1 运行。范围是根据同意屏幕上的功能授予的 - 域、应用程序、连接和会话的单独读写范围 - 并且您未授予范围的工具永远不会提供给助手。可以随时从仪表板中的“连接的应用程序”页面撤销连接的应用程序。工具响应是根据狭窄的合同编写的：永远不会返回秘密 API 密钥，并且根本无法通过插件访问 doDomain 的计费表面。

创建连接会话将计入您计划的每月连接配额；验证检查的速率受到限制，因此同一连接上的重复重新验证将被告知等待，而不是静默重试。

plugin_asdk_app_6a97e1d563d081918e018b4a.productIntro: Veille：电子邮件和增值税验证。
plugin_asdk_app_6a97e1d563d081918e018b4a.productIntroEn: Veille is an email, domain, phone, IP, VAT, and IBAN validation API for ChatGPT. Check signups, invoices, and traffic before you trust them.
plugin_asdk_app_6a97e1d563d081918e018b4a.longDescription:
Veille is an email, domain, phone, IP, VAT, and IBAN validation API for ChatGPT. Check signups, invoices, and traffic before you trust them.

Email validation flags disposable inboxes, role accounts, and a 0-100 risk score. Email qualification adds SMTP and catch-all. Domain checks disposable and MX health. Phone validation covers E.164 carrier and virtual numbers. IP reputation detects VPN, proxy, Tor, and datacenter. VAT uses VIES. IBAN returns bank and BIC. Exchange rates come from the ECB.

Sign in with your Veille account when you connect. Calls use the same credits and quotas as app.veille.io.
